This setting captures exit polling, where queries correspond to interviewing voters, and is closely related to problems in query complexity and property testing. Assuming that the margin of victory of the election is at least eps N, Dey, Kar and Sanyal (AAMAS 2023) gave algorithms for the case of two candidates with error probability del and query complexity tilde{O}(1/eps^6 log^2 1/del), which improves to tilde{O}(1/eps^4 log^2 1/del) under the additional assumption that district populations are balanced. Our main result is an adaptive randomised algorithm that, for an arbitrary district-based election and any error parameter del, with probability at least 1-del, predicts the winner correctly using tilde{O}(1/eps^2 log m/del log 1/del) queries. In particular, we improve the bounds of Dey et al. for arbitrary district populations and extend their results to any number of candidates. Furthermore, for constantly many candidates, our algorithm nearly matches a lower bound of Omega(1/eps^2 log 1/del) on the query complexity that holds even for two candidates and a single district.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在查询模型下预测基于选区选举结果的胜出者所需的查询复杂度。针对Dey、Kar和Sanyal (AAMAS 2023) 提出的两候选人问题，作者将查询复杂度从Õ(1/ε⁶ log²1/δ)（任意选区人口）或Õ(1/ε⁴ log²1/δ)（均衡选区）改进为Õ(1/ε² log(m/δ) log(1/δ))，适用于任意选区人口和任意数量的候选人，且对常数候选人数近乎匹配已知下界Ω(1/ε² log(1/δ))。
AI.motivation: 基于选区的选举制度（美、英、印等）通过地理分区聚合选票，预测其结果在出口民调、计算选举和社交选情调查中具有广泛应用。已有工作局限于两候选人情形且查询复杂度对ε的依赖较差（最高达1/ε⁶），亟需一种能处理任意候选人数和任意选区人口的最优查询算法。
AI.method: 关键技术包括：(1) 利用最优C可行策略将选区分为三类（𝒱₁,𝒱₂,𝒱₃），通过排序h(d)值并结合εN边际保证，引理4证明存在α∈[ε/16,1/2]使得至少有max{αk,1}个选区中h(d) > εN/(2⁵αg(ε)k)；(2) 定义"W-rich"和"C-poor"选区概念，引理7证明W-rich与C-poor选区数量差至少max{αk-1,0}；(3) 通过对数次的ε和α猜测迭代搜索，使用Bhattacharyya-Dey单选区预测器估计各候选人票数份额；(4) 对任意选区人口，按2的幂次将选区分为不同人口类别𝒱^r，并对每类独立估计。算法（Algorithm 2）以自适应随机方式执行。
AI.result: 主要结果（定理2）：对于具有任意选区人口和任意候选人数的一般δ-胜者预测问题，若MOV(E)≥εN，则存在算法以至少1-δ的概率正确预测胜者，查询复杂度为Õ(1/ε² log(m/δ) log(1/δ))。特别地，当候选人数为常数时，查询复杂度为Õ(1/ε² log²1/δ)，相对于Dey等人(2023)的ε⁴或ε⁶边界有指数级改进，并且对常数候选人数几乎匹配下界Ω(1/ε² log(1/δ))。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种针对一般基于选区选举的胜者预测器，对常数候选人数具有最优（至多polylog因子）的查询复杂度，对候选人数具有额外的logarithmic依赖。提出了若干未来研究方向：能否去除log m因子（开放问题）；研究其他投票规则下的查询复杂度（如批准投票、Borda计数等）；估计整体选举和单选区边议会的胜利边际幅度。

title: ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning
summary: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出ALER（Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting），一种结合LSTM与槽位记忆（slot memory）的部分可观测强化学习智能体，并形式化了部分可观测强化学习中三类记忆更新需求：保留（retention）、重写（rewriting）、经验融合（experience fusion）。同时构建了Rune-Mazes基准测试环境，用以系统评估智能体对存储信息的重写与按规则变换能力。ALER在重写任务（Endless T-Maze）和融合任务（Rune T-Maze、Rune-Mazes）上均显著优于七种基线方法，并通过探针分析验证了其记忆机制的合理性。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测强化学习中的记忆研究主要聚焦于保留（retention），即长期保持信息不变。然而，后来的观测可能使存储的信息失效或改变其含义。本文识别出两类被忽视的记忆需求：(1) 重写：将决策相关内容设为独立于旧值的新值；(2) 经验融合：依据后续观测指定的规则变换旧内容。现有的记忆架构与基准测试对这两类需求缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义三类记忆更新类别（retention/rewriting/experience fusion），并给出任务所需记忆状态数的理论下界（命题1、命题2）。2) ALER架构：LSTM跟踪每步变化的状态，槽位记忆保持持久内容；独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入机制可在一步内覆盖单个槽位；学习门控融合检索内容与循环状态。3) Rune-Mazes基准测试：包含Rune T-Maze（向量）、Rune Multi-Corridor（向量，多分支）、Rune MiniGrid Memory（像素观测），通过Invert、SkipNext、ResetRules、RepeatPrev等符文（rune）测试不同更新规则。4) 与7种基线对比：PPO-LSTM、GTrXL、Resettable S5、FFM、SHM、DNC、PPO-MLP。5) 通过线性探针与门控消融分析ALER内部表征与机制。
AI.result: 1) Endless T-Maze（重写任务）：ALER在全部16个配置上成功率均≥0.82（其中15个为1.00），在3倍训练走廊长度下仍保持1.0分辨率，显著优于多数基线。2) Rune T-Maze（融合任务）：ALER在全部5种符文组合上成功率均≥0.99。3) Rune Multi-Corridor（K=4分支）：在含Invert符文时，ALER平均成功率为0.83±0.17，为最高。K≥8时，所有架构成功率均较低。4) Rune MiniGrid Memory（像素观测）：在10个配置中有8个，ALER平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM。5) 机制分析：探针显示ALER的存储行为符合理论中的"延迟求解"模式——槽位记忆存储初始线索，循环状态解码符文标志；在符文步骤上，门控变化幅度显著高于匹配的非符文步骤，表明门控承担了按规则变换记忆的融合角色。6) 极限情况：K≥8的Rune Multi-Corridor对所有架构仍是开放难题。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统化了部分可观测强化学习中三类记忆更新需求（保留、重写、经验融合），提出了相应的理论下界与组合任务最简自动机分析方法。ALER将三类需求分配到不同模块（LSTM+槽位记忆+学习门控），在重写与融合任务上均取得领先性能，并具备良好的长度泛化能力。Rune-Mazes基准测试弥补了现有评测对融合任务的空白。未来工作需解决更大目标空间（K≥8）下的记忆与推理难题。

title: MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $\pi_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: MIKASA-Robo-VLA是一个面向长视野操作任务的基准测试,包含90个语言条件操控任务,系统性地评估VLA模型的记忆能力。通过控制提示消失后的信息间隔,提供了10种记忆类型和3种视野分层,并发布了22,500条示范轨迹用于训练评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型通常仅依赖当前帧或极少的历史帧进行决策,难以系统评估其对任务中已消失信息的利用能力;现有基准如CALVIN和LIBERO侧重技能组合与知识迁移,而记忆专项基准如MemoryBench、RoboMME等覆盖范围有限,缺乏对记忆内容与保留间隔的精细控制。
AI.method: 在ManiSkill 3中扩展MIKASA-Robo,从32个任务扩展至90个语言条件操控任务,涵盖10种记忆类型(物体、空间、容量、时间、负集、序列、程序、前瞻、追踪、清单)和26个任务家族;通过环境阶段时序定义信息间隔,分为Short/Medium/Long三层视野(25-2160步);发布RLDS与LeRobotDataset v3双格式的22,500条oracle示范;提供统一的观测-动作接口、稠密奖励和固定种子评估协议;以π₀.₅作为无记忆参考基线,并分析OpenVLA-OFT与μVLA在记忆增强架构上的对比。
AI.result: 基准包含90个任务、22,500集、6,306,953帧(10Hz下约175小时);70个任务有明确信息间隔,其中28个超过最宽固定上下文窗口(16帧);参考π₀.₅基线在14个任务上微调后平均任务成功率0.211±0.044,Long分层表现受开环分块与子集记忆类型混淆影响;μVLA相比无记忆OpenVLA-OFT在记忆依赖任务上有显著提升(如RememberColor5:0.04→0.94);机会水平接近零(4500集仅1次成功)。
AI.conclusion: MIKASA-Robo-VLA提供了标准化的任务套件、数据集和诊断工具(分类法、信息间隔指标、机会下界),作为评估VLA记忆能力的基础设施;而非对记忆策略优劣的结论性回答。其26个任务家族与oracle轨迹为后续训练和比较记忆增强VLA策略提供了固定目标,统一的任务族奖励与成功定义可供任何方法对比。

title: Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities
summary: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Waldo基准，用于评估大语言模型在跨语言知识差异（知识缺口和知识冲突）下的查询语言偏好。研究发现，在知识冲突场景下，模型显著倾向于采用与查询语言相同的文档作为依据，并探索了注意力头消融和QLoRA微调两种缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多语言信息检索场景中，常表现出"查询语言偏好"——倾向于优先采用与查询语言一致的来源信息。先前工作大多假设各语言来源信息等价，但现实中跨语言知识往往不完整或存在冲突，这种偏好会产生严重后果：用户所获取的信息取决于模型的来源选择，可能导致不同语言用户获得不一致的回答，损害多语言信息公平性。
AI.method: 1. 构建Waldo基准：基于维基百科构建12K多语言QA对，跨越法语、中文、日语、韩语、孟加拉语五种源语言，包含"知识缺口"（某语言有而另一语言缺失的事实）和"知识冲突"（不同语言版本对同一事实给出冲突描述）两类场景。2. 提出两个评估指标：答案一致率（Answer Agreement）和答案概率（Answer Probability），固定多语言上下文，仅变化查询语言。3. 评估8个模型（开源+闭源），并测试检索增强场景下的泛化性。4. 提出两种缓解方法：QPHA（通过梯度-激活归因识别与查询语言偏好相关的注意力头并进行消融）和QLoRA微调（采用Promote和Contrastive两种自定义目标）。
AI.result: 1. 知识缺口场景：闭源模型基本克服了查询语言偏好；开源模型（LLaMA-3.1、Qwen-3、Aya-Expanse）仍存在显著偏好，差距达12-18%。2. 知识冲突场景：所有8个模型均表现出强烈的查询语言偏好，平均答案一致率差距达55.7%，概率差距也显著增大。低资源语言（孟加拉语）表现尤为明显。3. 偏好具有对称性：交换文档角色后，偏好方向也随之反转，排除基准构造不对称性的影响。4. 混淆因素分析：预训练效应、嵌入相似性、表面线索和主题本土性均不能解释该偏好。5. 缓解效果：QPHA（k=8）使一致率差距平均降低4.8个百分点，效果优于随机消融；QLoRA对比学习目标可将偏好差距减少高达61.5%，效果显著优于QPHA。6. 检索增强实验表明该现象在多源环境中依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 查询语言偏好是大型语言模型在跨语言知识差异场景下的显著且稳健的行为特征，尤其在知识冲突条件下，所有评估模型均强烈倾向于采纳查询语言匹配的文档，导致语义等价的查询在不同语言下产生不同答案。该偏好不能归因于预训练效应、嵌入相似性、文档长度/位置或主题文化特异性等混淆因素。机制层面的注意力头消融（QPHA）和训练层面的QLoRA微调均能有效缓解该问题，其中QLoRA对比学习目标表现尤为显著。研究强调了在多语言信息系统中保障公平信息访问的重要性，并指出未来应将该评估扩展至维基百科以外的多语言信息源（如学术论文），并研究其对用户理解与信任的实际影响。

title: Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking
summary: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于模式连接和低损失区域几何的分析框架，论证grokking现象的根源在于训练集与验证集所诱导的低损失区域之间的"错位"(misalignment)，并通过在OpenAI模运算设置中构造一个"反grokking"反例来验证该框架。
AI.motivation: Grokking（先过拟合训练集、之后才在验证集上泛化）作为深度学习中的一种涌现现象，其底层机制至今未有统一答案。既有研究（Fourier电路、Slingshot效应、训练集阈值、Hessian几何、权重衰减、信息论解释等）虽揭示了多种相关指标，但未能给出完整的因果解释。本文旨在建立一个能统一解释这些观察的因果框架。
AI.method: 1) 建立低损失区域（LLR）的形式化定义：LLR(M,D,L_th)为参数空间中损失低于阈值的区域，由架构、数据集和损失函数唯一确定，与优化器无关。2) 利用LLPF算法在M_grok架构与D_mod(x+y,97)上验证模式连接（mode connectivity），并提出Conjecture 1：低损失区域是单一路径连通区域。3) 在权重空间中建立训练LLR与验证LLR的几何关系（重叠与非重叠区域），将Liu et al.(2022)的四种学习阶段（理解、顿悟、记忆、困惑）对应到不同空间轨迹。5) 构造"反grokking"反例：保持模加法对称性f(a,b)=f(b,a)，让所有对称对(a,b)和(b,a)属于同一划分，从而消除grokking。6) 引入"对称感知训练覆盖率C_sym(T)"作为有效信息熵的经验代理。7) 设计嵌套数据集D_mod1997(f,n)，通过学习率与权重衰减网格扫描得到的相图作为低损失区域对齐程度的间接探针。8) 通过改变模型规模（×0.5、×1、×2）验证模型容量对错位程度的影响。
AI.result: 1) 成功复现OpenAI的grokking设置，并在M_grok、D_mod(x+y,97)上验证了模式连接（路径上最大损失<1.5×10⁻³，最小准确率>99.85%，10次重复稳定）。2) "反grokking"反例成功：保持架构、优化器、数据集大小、任务族不变，仅将对称对分配到同一划分后，验证准确率不再恢复，10个随机种子稳定复现。3) 该反例证伪了三种既有grokking指标：(a) Slingshot效应仍出现但无grokking；(b) Fourier成分仍有差异但不能预测grokking；(c) 固定训练集大小时grokking仍可消失。4) 在反grokking设置中，将同一划分比例从100%降至70%时grokking逐渐重现。6) 嵌套数据集相图显示：随n从97增至1997，Memorization格子减少直至消失，Comprehension格子增多，表明对齐程度提高，Grokking格子不再出现。7) 模型规模实验显示：较小模型Comprehension格子更多（更对齐），较大模型Comprehension格子稀少（更错位）。8) 不同函数对比：f(x,y)=x²+y²的LLR最对齐，f(x,y)=x+y居中，f(x,y)=2x²+y最错位；f(x,y)=xy²与f(x,y)=x²+2y²各自可训练，但其和f(x,y)=x²+2y²+xy在相同扫描下不可训练。9) 对称感知训练覆盖率在随机划分40%与45%之间（0.637→0.695）以及反grokking的70%与60%之间（0.648→0.680）发生异常转化，过渡区间存在重合。
AI.conclusion: grokking由两个分层因素共同决定：(1) 主因——训练集与验证集诱导的低损失区域的错位，由架构与数据集决定；错位更可能发生在训练信息相对模型表达能力较少时；(2) 次因——训练轨迹，由权重衰减、学习率、初始化等超参数共同决定。当主因导致低损失区域充分对齐时，仅靠次因无法产生grokking，训练动态坍缩为可训练或不可训练。grokking与记忆化均表明训练数据相对于模型架构不足。grokking不应被视为神经网络的某种隐藏能力，而应被理解为数据不足导致延迟泛化的预警信号。论文的局限性：模运算数据无噪声、对称性知识在通用数据集中无直接对应、50%训练划分在实践中不常见。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
summary: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

AI.tldr: 本文提出RuleEvolve框架，通过LLM驱动的变异器和评判器模块，自动迭代进化AI编码代理的编码规则（如AGENTS.md），在保持代码功能正确性的同时显著降低代码长度和生成成本。
AI.motivation: 现有AI编码代理的编码规则几乎全部由人工编写，存在劳动密集、缺乏任务特定对齐甚至会降低代理性能的问题。现有提示词优化技术难以直接应用于长文档化的编码规则，因其搜索空间大且评估成本高。
AI.method: RuleEvolve维护固定大小为m的候选规则池，通过LLM驱动的变异器模块生成N个变体，并使用评判器模块打分。提出基于最优计算预算分配（OCBA）的策略性变异分配方法，根据候选规则的均值和方差动态分配变异次数，优先变异高性能方差大或均值接近最优的候选。优化目标为带正确性约束的代码长度最小化问题。
AI.result: 在两种编码代理框架（OpenHands、OpenAI SDK）、四种骨干LLM（gpt-4.1-mini、gpt-5-mini、gpt-5.3-codex、Qwen-Coder-30B）和三个基准测试（BigCodeBench、BigCodeBench-Hard、HumanEval）上，RuleEvolve在通过率、代码字符数和Token消耗上均取得最优或相当的性能。例如在BigCodeBench上使用gpt-5.3-codex时代码长度减少超过60%。在SWE-Bench Lite上也验证了泛化能力，PR达到0.340。消融实验验证了OCBA分配策略优于均匀和比例分配。
AI.conclusion: RuleEvolve是首个针对AI编码代理长文档化编码规则的自动自进化框架，通过迭代变异-剪枝和策略性变异分配，有效平衡了功能正确性、代码简洁度和生成成本，为编码规则自动化优化开辟了新方向。

title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StepRS-GRPO，一种针对扩散语言模型(dLLM)的按状态调度风险敏感强化学习方法，通过在去噪过程中对不同去噪状态分配不同的风险系数，在数学推理任务上同时提升准确率、解覆盖度和输出多样性。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型(dLLM)通过多步去噪并行生成token，但其RLVR(可验证奖励强化学习)训练将终端反馈均匀地复用于所有去噪步去噪决策，忽略了不同去噪状态的上下文差异。已有研究表明更高的pass@1不一定意味着更好的pass@k覆盖度，也不一定意味着推理策略的多样性，因此核心挑战在于：如何在不坍缩搜索分布的前提下提升dLLM的推理准确率？
AI.method: 1. 在RS-GRPO(风险敏感GRPO)基础上引入按状态调度的风险系数，对每个去噪决策根据其归一化状态坐标u∈[0,1]查询调度表b(u)，获得状态相关的风险系数β=b(u)；2. 对二元奖励，证明该变换精确等价于对中心化优势进行依赖于提示和状态的重缩放A_j^c c_j = c_β(p̂_q)·A_j^0；3. 提出能力导向的系数标度选择β*=−log(1−p̄)，匹配失败率降低比例；4. 默认采用线性半衰减调度，将较大风险系数分配给更遮蔽的状态；5. 通过C1(移除状态变化)、C2(反向调度)、C3(优势RMS匹配)三个机制对照验证各部分贡献。
AI.result: 在SDAR-1.7B-Chat、SDAR-4B-Chat和Qwen3-0.6B-MDLM三种dLLM骨架上，在MATH500、AMC23、AIME2024、AIME2025、GSM8K等数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO在所有评估的pass@k预算下均优于中心化GRPO。例如SDAR-1.7B在AIME2024上pass@1从3.90提升至9.60，AIME2025从2.40提升至8.30；pass@64在AIME上分别获得10.00和6.68个百分点的提升。唯一答案比和推理轨迹多样性(Self-BLEU-4互补和嵌入距离)也均提升。在匹配优势RMS后增益依然存在，表明增益并非仅来源于优势幅度变化。
AI.conclusion: StepRS-GRPO通过按去噪状态调度风险系数，在保持原生训练器不变的前提下同时改善了dLLM的推理准确率、解覆盖度和输出多样性。能力校准为系数选择提供了实用起点，线性半衰减是有效的默认调度。局限性包括：能力规则指导端点选择但不确立最优方案；评估聚焦于二元奖励的数学任务；三个推理种子量化了固定检查点的采样变异性而非训练运行的变异性。

title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.

AI.tldr: 本文针对循环语言模型(Looped Language Models)提出了两套实用训练方案：一是将从头训练的数据量从7.7T tokens压缩到310B tokens的简化两阶段方案；二是仅用一个学习标量加平滑退出损失即可将预训练稠密模型转换为循环模型。
AI.motivation: 现有循环语言模型(如Ouro)需要五阶段、7.7T tokens的多阶段训练，成本高昂；且其增益难以与数据、训练差异分离，循环机制本身的贡献未被独立验证。本文旨在提供更便宜、可控、可分离增益的循环模型训练方案。
AI.method: 方法分两条路径：(1) 从头训练：采用单次210B token预训练+100B token高质量mid-training的两阶段方案，T=4固定循环深度，使用学习率warmup防止早期退出门坍缩，β=0.15允许恢复；mid-training使用HRM-Text数据。(2) 稠密转循环：对Qwen3-1.7B-Base应用T=3循环，引入单一学习标量w将原始token嵌入按z_t=w·e+(1-w)·h_{t-1}混入后续步骤，并使用平滑退出损失(ε=0.05)确保每步获得最小LM权重。两条路径均设计了参数匹配(dense-ouro-1.4B/Qwen3-1.7B-Base)与推理计算匹配(dense-ouro-3.9B/Qwen3-4B-Base)的稠密对照基线。
AI.result: (1) 1.4B LoopLM在12项基准上全部超过参数匹配的1.4B稠密模型，GSM8K +14、MATH +10、DROP +22、CRUXEval-I +17；3步推理时与3.9B稠密模型在数学和阅读理解上接近(GSM8K/MATH差距在一个标准误内)，(MATH、MLU等知识类基准) 仍由更大稠密模型领先。(2) Looped Qwen在60B token指令数据和84B token网页数据两种体系下均超过继续训练同数据的Qwen3-1.7B-Base，指令数据下GSM8K +4.3、MMLU-Pro +3.8、MATH +2.2均超过两倍标准误。(3) 训练FLOPs：从头方案仅用Ouro的约3%，稠密转循环仅用原预训练的0.5%。(4) 额外发现：post-norm饱和规范化导致梯度集中于最后一层，训练失效；RLTT在rollout解题率适中时有效，解题率过高则无效。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了循环语言模型既可低成本从头训练，也可廉价转换为现有预训练检查点，并通过对消融设计和共享消融实验明确隔离了循环机制本身的增益。退出门坍缩与规范化失效是两种独立的训练不稳定性，需warmup+β组合应对；稠密到微转换无需逐步参数，标量注入加平滑退出损失即足够。推理计算匹配下更大稠密模型在知识存储类任务仍占优，说明循环主要改进的是模型接近"有效深度"的能力而非参数存储的事实。

title: LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出LabBook，一种用于LLM驱动科学发现的轻量级单智能体框架，通过agent维护的自然语言记忆（LabBook）与只读检索接口，将完整实验日志保留与选择性上下文构建解耦，在58个发现任务上以更低成本取得与或优于进化基线的质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的进化式发现系统通常从少量"祖先程序"生成新方案，上下文可控却会丢弃大量有用实验证据；而若引入完整历史又会产生冗长低效的上下文。核心信息瓶颈在于"实验保留"与"提案上下文构建"两个决策被耦合在一起，缺少一种既能无损记录所有实验、又能按需构建紧凑相关上下文的机制。
AI.method: 将发现过程形式化为"实验历史→下一提案上下文"映射 Γ。提出LabBook：单智能体维护一份自由形式的自然语言记忆（记录尝试思路、关键实现细节、教训与未解决方向），配合一个只读的"粗到精"检索接口（History概览、按索引返回Code(i)/Result(i)、Done终止），作用于一个append-only的完整实验记录上。每只调同时输入最新一次实验、LabBook与确定性的best-so-far进度信号，由同一智能体在至多K=5次检索后联合输出新程序与更新后的LabBook。不显式维护种群或分支搜索结构，无需采样器超参数或多智能体分工。
AI.result: 在49个Frontier-CS问题+9个数学/系统/启发式设计任务（共58个）上，使用DeepSeek V4 Flash与Qwen 3.6 Flash两个骨干，相比OpenEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX三个进化基线：成本-性能权衡更优；在Frontier-CS均值上较最强基线提升6.13（DeepSeek, +16.3%）与6.91（Qwen, +20.9%）分；达相同AdaEvolve终值成本降低30.2%–48.8%；在9任务上获得7–9个最佳/并列最佳；消融显示"持久记忆+全检索引"协同贡献最大（归一化均值0.9982 vs Full History 0.9488且成本减半）；Heilbronn凸包案例显示LabBook能跨越44只调回溯检索iter 33的强基线并产出新最佳0.947325。
AI.conclusion: 证明有效的LLM驱动发现不必依赖日益复杂的搜索结构；将"无损实验日志+agent维护的紧凑语义状态+选择性检索"三者解耦即可在广泛任务上同时改善质量与成本，并支持跨长程迭代的远端代码回收。Análise de extensões a fluxos científicos ruidosos, parcialmente observados e não programáticos é apontada como direção futura promissora.

title: Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出USB+ATR方法,通过目标条件双模拟学习动作感知时序表示(ATR)与可迁移技能发现(USB),在单一训练布局上学习能在未见布局中有效迁移的通用技能,显著优于现有离线目标条件RL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督技能发现方法存在两大缺陷:距离最大化方法(如HILP)过度拟合训练布局的全局时序结构,无法迁移到未见布局;行为克隆方法虽泛化性好但依赖专家/高质量数据,在次优数据上表现差。需要一种既能利用次优数据又能在布局变化时保持技能行为一致性的方法。
AI.method: 两个核心组件:(1) ATR(动作感知时序表示):用动作ℓ1距离(而非奖励)作为度量训练目标条件双模拟嵌入ψ,使具有相似动作序列的状态-目标对在表示空间中接近;再通过公式φ(s)-φ(s')=ψ(s,s')-E[ψ(s,s)]约束局部时序依赖与三角不等式,实现函数等变性。(2) USB(双模拟技能发现):基于ATR的时地位移差异用双模拟训练β表示,将动态相似状态映射到相近嵌入;技能策略π^l(·|β(s),z)仅以β而非完整状态为条件,迫使技能忽略布局无关特征。训练时使用动力学模型f构造匹配动作对以适应离线设定,技能方向奖励定义为R=⟨φ(s')-φ(s), z⟩。
AI.result: 在OGBench的pointmaze和antmaze扩展基准上(新增随机布局生成功能):(1) 分层RL设置中,USB+ATR平均成功率82.85%,远超HILP(52.33%)、OPAL(44.05%)和flat策略(0.63%);在antmaze-stitch-large等任务上从HILP的65.2%提升至78.9%。(2) 测试时规划设置中,USB+ATR平均52.19%,优于GCIQL(45.59%)、QRL(30.81%)等;在antmaze任务上以巨大优势领先(66.3% vs 14.0%最佳基线)。(3) 消融实验证实ATR与USB具有协同性,缺一不可;对动力学模型容量的鲁棒性较好(小模型MSE高10×仍达59.1%)。(4) 人工控制实验表明四个学习的技能足以驱动ant通过未见迷宫。
AI.conclusion: USB+ATR通过结合功能等变性的时序表示和基于动态相似性的条件化技能,有效解决了无监督技能发现中布局迁移的难题,为离线目标条件RL中的分布外泛化提供了新范式。未来方向包括将对称度量空间扩展到拟度量架构、处理随机环境以及在机器人操作等任务上定义新的布局泛化基准。

title: How Divergence Becomes Decision Flips in Compressed Language Models
summary: Compression reports summarize how far a compressed language model moved from the dense one, usually by a KL divergence; a deployment that relies on the dense model's outputs needs to know how many of its decisions changed. We show that total variation, not KL, answers this directly. Across 802 compressed and perturbed copies of 19 open models on five corpora and nine mechanically unrelated perturbation families, the rate at which the arg-max token changes (the \emph{flip rate}) tracks total variation at a ratio with median $1.05$, with no fitted constant. KL converts into flips only through its square root and a factor that varies fourfold across models and corpora, because KL averages over tokens before the root is taken; first-order statistics averaged per token, such as Hellinger distance, avoid this, but reports rarely give them. As a result, of two compressors reported on different models and corpora whose flip rates differ by at least $10%$, KL assigns the smaller divergence to the one that changes more decisions in $11%$ of cases, total variation in $1%$. Two pre-registered tests mark the limits: on a held-out code corpus the ratio held for all eight models while three predictions about KL each failed for half of them or more, and on three new models with real kernels it stayed in its band for 37 of 38 checkpoints but fell below one on code for two models. In vLLM speculative decoding, total variation measured under teacher forcing predicts greedy draft acceptance with a mean relative error of $1.1$--$2.4%$, without the task-specific calibration that KL needs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了压缩语言模型中分布散度（divergence）与决策翻转（arg-max token变化）之间的定量关系。通过对19个开源模型的802个压缩与扰动副本在五个语料库上的系统实验，发现总变差（Total Variation, TV）与翻转率呈近1:1的比例（中位数1.05），而KL散度需通过平方根转换且其系数因模型和语料不同而变化4倍。KL的语料依赖性主要源于其对token的预先平均（Jensen因子）。在vLLM推测解码中，TV预测贪婪草稿接受的平均相对误差仅为1.1%-2.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型压缩评估通常使用KL散度来衡量压缩模型与稠密模型之间的差异，但实际部署中（特别是推测解码、缓存去重等场景）需要知道有多少决策发生了变化。本文旨在回答一个核心问题：报告中的KL散度（或TV、JS等）究竟如何转化为token决策的变化，以及这种转换是否在不同压缩方法、模型和语料库间保持一致。
AI.method:
1. 在teacher forcing条件下，对19个开源模型进行9种机械无关的扰动（RTN、KV-cache量化、高斯噪声、幅度剪枝、GPTQ、AWQ、Wanda、SparseGPT、单层/层移除），共产生802个压缩/扰动配置。
2. 在5个语料库（gsm8k、mix、mmlu-en、wikitext、wikitext-nat）和1个保留语料（MBPP代码）上测量每个位置的总变差、KL散度和翻转率。
3. 通过精确的恒等分解将flip/√KL分解为三个因子：flip/TV（逐token一阶统计量之比）、c（逐token转换因子，受Pinsker不等式约束）、J（Jensen因子，衡量散度在token间的集中度）。
4. 使用两个预注册测试验证结论的泛化性：一个在保留代码语料库上（8个模型），另一个在三个新模型上使用真实推理核（NF4、int8、FP8及AWQ/GPTQ发布检查点）。
5. 在vLLM中部署推测解码，测试TV对贪婪草稿接受的预测能力。
AI.result:
1. 翻转率与总变差的比值在所有802个配置中中位数为1.05（95%在0.89-1.29），无需任何拟合常数。9个扰动家族共享同一条曲线（偏差≤5%）。
2. KL需要乘以√KL转换，且其系数κ在不同模型和语料库间变化达3.6-4.0倍。在跨报告比较中（不同模型/语料），KL在10.8%的情况下将较小散度分配给了翻转更多的配置，而TV仅为1.3%。
3. 分解显示KL的语料依赖性有70%来自Jensen因子J（衡量散度在token间的均匀程度）；在GSM8K上J=0.9（散度集中于少数token），在自然文本上J=0.75。
4. 证明了一个小噪声各向同性极限（Proposition 1），表明flip/TV的近单位比值是稠密模型输出分布的固有属性，可从纯密度推导预测flip/TV，中位误差仅3.2%。
5. 预注册测试：8个模型在保留代码语料库上，flip/TV比值在所有模型中成立（0.98-1.05），但关于KL的三个预测每个都在半数以上失灵。三个新模型（Qwen2.5-14B、Mistral-Nemo、Granite-3.3-8B）的真实核测试中，37/38检查点保持在公布范围内。
6. vLLM推测解码中，TV预测贪婪接受的平均相对误差为1.1-2.4%，而KL需要任务特定校准且误差为2.5-22.3%。
7. 例外情况：FP8产生非有限logits（12次运行中10次），层移除的偏离度为0.945（唯一经检验显著偏离的家族），Mistral-Nemo在代码语料库上flip/TV降至0.91。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：对于需要精确匹配稠密模型决策的应用（如推测解码、缓存去重、回归测试），总变差（TV）应取代KL散度作为报告的统计量。KL的语料依赖性源于其对token的预先平均效应（Jensen因子），导致跨报告比较时频繁误排序（11% vs 0.7-1.3%）。TV的近单位翻转率比值是稠密模型输出分布的内在性质，可不依赖任何拟合常数预测翻转数。然而，本文揭示的局限性是：这些统计量衡量的是对稠密模型的保真度，而非基准任务质量（同一GSM8K KL下，幅度剪枝损失33.3分而Wanda增益4.8分）；范围限于1B-72B参数的稠密 decoder-only Transformer，post-training压缩，greedy解码，10⁻³至约2 nats的散度范围。

title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM驱动发现（LLM-driven discovery）中初始化的重要性。作者构建了12种"Modular"发现框架变体，在5个不同发现任务上进行实验，发现：(1) 顺序发现框架虽常优于纯并行发现，但最佳框架设计因任务和LLM而异；(2) 顺序发现容易发生"模式坍缩"，且多样性干预措施（如SOTA框架ShinkaEvolve、OpenEvolve、optimize_anything）增益不稳定；(3) 早期发现质量可预测最终成功。据此提出一种通用干预方法：先用一部分计算预算进行并行探索以生成高性能初始种群，再用其预热顺序发现框架。该方法在多种框架和任务上一致带来2%–21%的性能提升，验证了初始化在LLM驱动发现中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: LLM已被用于算法、药物、定理等的自动化发现，但现有工作多关注harness（提示词框架）的顺序设计，对初始化策略关注不足。作者观察到LLM驱动发现结果对初始种子和框架选择很脆弱，亟需理解初始发现与下游发现质量之间的关系。
AI.method: 1. 泛化OPRO框架，提出"Modular"harness套件（4种突变策略×3种父代采样策略=12种变体）。2. 在5个多样化发现任务（CloudCast、Can't Be Late、Circle Packing、TSP、Prompt优化）上，对比顺序与并行发现。3. 分析模式坍缩现象及多样性干预措施（相似度阈值、LLM判断器、去重）。4. 提出初始化干预：用部分预算并行生成候选池，按相似度阈值s=0.98筛选高性能初始种群（m=15）来初始化顺序框架。5. 基于收敛准则（最佳候选在N%预算内未提升δ）自动确定初始化预算比例。6. 在SOTA框架（ShinkaEvolve、OpenEvolve、optimize_anything）上验证初始化效果。
AI.result: 1. 顺序发现通常优于并行发现，但最佳框架因任务/LLM而异，LLM驱动发现具有脆弱性。2. 顺序发现普遍出现模式坍缩（多样性下降）。4. 多样性干预和SOTA框架虽提升种群多样性，但未带来一致的性能提升。5. 前15个发现的中位分数与最终最佳分数呈正相关。6. 提出的初始化方法在所有任务、LLM和框架上一致优于纯顺序(r=0)和纯并行(r=1)发现；在SOTA框架上带来2%–21%的额外提升。7. 收敛准则在9/13场景下成功预测最佳初始化预算比例。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动发现结果对harness设计高度敏感（脆弱性），且多样性诱导干预措施效果不稳定。早期发现质量是最终成功的强预测因子。本文提出的简单、与harness/任务/LLM无关的初始化干预方法（并行预算→高性能初始种群→预热顺序框架）一致提升了发现性能，证实了初始化在LLM驱动发现中的核心重要性。未来工作应进一步研究LLM参数化知识对发现质量的影响。

title: Sequential Functional Structured Tucker Compression for Large Language Model Attentions
summary: Post-training compression of LLM attention is often formulated as independent matrix approximation, ignoring both the shared structure among attention projections and the representation shift introduced by earlier compression. We propose FTC, a sequential structured compression framework that adapts the approximation to the current compressed model while jointly exploiting the native Q/K/V head structure under a fixed storage budget. The output projection is handled separately to account for the changed post-attention representation. FTC requires neither fine-tuning nor gradient-based recovery. Across seven decoder-only LLMs from 6B to 32B parameters, FTC achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity among the compared methods at every tested keep ratio on five modern GQA models, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. The improvements transfer to downstream tasks and remain substantial at the 32B scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FTC，一种用于LLM注意力模块训练后压缩的结构化框架，通过序列化的激活诱导度量联合利用Q/K/V共享的Tucker结构，并在固定存储预算下联合分配秩与稀疏核心容量，无需微调或梯度恢复即可在多个6B–32B模型上实现优于现有方法的压缩-性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM注意力压缩方法通常将Q/K/V投影视为独立的低秩矩阵近似，忽略了三个投影间的共享特征结构；此外，这些方法通常基于原始（教师）激活构建度量，而忽略了先前压缩步骤带来的表示偏移。输出投影W_O作用于不同的注意力输出表示，也需要单独处理。因此需要一个能够适应已压缩学生模型状态、联合利用Q/K/V原生头结构、并对W_O单独处理的序列化结构化压缩框架。
AI.method: FTC包含三个核心组件：(1) 激活诱导度量——从当前学生模型的隐藏表示构建正则化的经验Gram矩阵，通过Cholesky白化转化为欧几里得张量近似问题；(2) 联合Q/K/V结构化Tucker压缩——将Q/K/V头沿第三模式堆叠成三维张量，共享前两个Tucker因子U_1, U_2，保留每个头切片的核心系数，并通过切片平衡权重防止高能量投影主导共享子空间；(3) 输出投影W_O的单独处理——使用更新后的注意力表示构建度量，并通过闭式解构建匹配教师分支输出的正则化校准目标。此外，还提出了预算耦合的秩-稀疏分配方案，在固定存储预算下联合选择Tucker秩和稀疏核心基数，通过渐进式剪枝与支撑约束重拟合交替进行精炼。
AI.result: 在七个6B–32B参数的解码器LLL（GPT-J-6B、Llama-2-13B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B）上的实验表明：FTC在所有测试保留率下均取得最低的WikiText-2困惑度，尤其在五个现代GQA模型上ρ=0.2时，比最佳基线降低39%–88%的困惑度；同时下游任务（六个多选题平均及5-shot GSM8K）性能显著提升，且无需任何微调或梯度恢复。消融实验表明度量白化、序列化校准、联合张量化在更激进的预算下越发重要。
AI.conclusion: FTC通过激活诱导度量、序列化适应、联合Q/K/V张量化及预算耦合秩-稀疏分配的结合，在不需微调或梯度恢复的情况下，在6B–32B规模MHA与GQA LLM上均实现了比现有方法更优的压缩-性能权衡。消融研究证实各部分在激进压缩下均贡献显著，尤其在GQA架构上优势更为明显。

title: Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations
summary: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个基于真实气象站观测的生成式数据同化受控基准测试，在11,849个NOAA MADIS气象站上评估了5种生成式方法与2种经典基线，得出三大结论：学习到的生成先验优于3D-Var的高斯先验（RMSE降低35.7% vs 33.3%）、全梯度引导优于停止梯度和初始噪声优化、扩散模型与流匹配在匹配条件下表现几乎相同。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式数据同化方法通常在合成观测或不同数据集与评估方案下进行评估，导致难以判断哪些设计选择真正改善了真实世界的数据同化性能。此外，生成式方法尚未在受控条件下进行系统比较，无法回答生成式与经典方法在真实站观测上的相对优劣、不同生成框架（扩散 vs 流匹配、像素 vs 潜空间）的影响以及哪些设计选择驱动性能提升。
AI.method: 在固定数据集、观测算子和深度学习架构的条件下，比较3D-Var基线、Diffusion-SDA、Flow Guidance、FlowDPS、D-Flow、Latent 3D-Var和Latent Flow Guidance七种方法。生成式学习包括扩散模型和流匹配（共享U-Net骨干，约3.8M参数），先验使用EDM框架统一表述。条件注入策略包括：全梯度引导（通过去噪器/速度网络反向传播）、停止梯度引导（FlowDPS在终端空间优化）、初始噪声优化（D-Flow端到端优化x₀）。潜空间方案使用卷积VAE，变量分组G∈{1,4}控制跨变量混合，下采样深度S∈{2,3,4}。观测算子使用双三次插值将网格场映射到站位。评估指标为360个快照的RMSE相对于ERA5基线的改进百分比，涵盖稠密（11,849站）和稀疏（1,000站）两种基准。
AI.result: 在稠密基准上，Flow Guidance和Diffusion-SDA均达到约35.7%/35.4%的RMSE改进，分别优于3D-Var的33.3%约2.4个百分点，优于D-Flow约5个百分点（30.5%）。Flow Guidance使用半倍显存（3.05 vs 6.12 GB）和单一超参数。在稀疏基准上，生成式方法的优势从2.4pp扩大到7.9pp，停止梯度引导崩溃至7.6%，D-Flow降至12.6%。扩散与流匹配在两种基准下均达到统计平价。潜空间方案在稠密基准上不优于像素空间（最佳配置低1.4pp），但在稀疏基准上可匹配像素空间精度且节省约40%显存。变量混合（G=1）与空间混合（G=4）在自编码器中表现相当。所有方法在风场上的改进均大于温度和露点（归一化信号比约2.4倍）。空间传播分析表明，生成式方法的修正可延伸至约120公里（四倍ERA5网格间距），且在距离站位较远处优于3D-Var；但在远离站位的区域缺乏ERA5回退，温度和露点估计可能比ERA5更差。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的生成先验比3D-Var中的ERA5背景场提供更有效的正则化，使生成式方法在有真实站观测的情况下优于经典变分方法。全梯度引导是唯一在稠密和稀疏两种基准上均优于3D-Var的条件注入策略。Flow Guidance是实际最佳选择：与Diffusion-SDA精度相当，显存减半，仅需调一个超参数。扩散和流匹配在该任务上达到平价，潜空间和变量混合未提供可测量的收益。稀疏观测放大了方法间的泛化差异。未来方向包括：将ERA5作为生成先验的回退机制、引入时间一致性约束、耦合降尺度模型以及加入集合校准指标（如CRPS）进行更全面的评估。

title: Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了网络宽度对自监督学习中贪心逐层训练（greedy layer-wise training）与端到端反向传播训练性能关系的影响，发现在较浅且非常宽的网络中，贪心逐层训练可以匹配甚至超越端到端反向传播训练的表现。
AI.motivation: 端到端反向传播在生物学上不太合理，因为它需要全局的信用分配方式。相比之下，大脑中的网络较为浅层且宽，可能更适合局部学习规则。然而，先前的研究尚未系统阐明在何种架构条件下，限制信用分配范围的局部训练（如贪心逐层训练）能够产生与端到端训练相媲美的表征。本研究旨在填补这一知识空白，特别是在自监督学习（SSL）的背景下。
AI.method: 使用 Barlow Twins 损失函数（主要实验）和 SimCLR 损失函数，在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 数据集上训练了不同宽度的卷积神经网络（Conv4 和 Conv8）。对比了贪心逐层训练与端到端反向传播训练两种方式。此外，分析了网络的表示几何性质（信号-信号分解度（SSF）和信号-噪声分解度（SNF））以解释性能差异。
AI.result: 1. 在较窄网络中，端到端训练表现更优；增加宽度时，两种方法的性能差距缩小。2. 在较浅且非常宽的 Conv4 网络中，贪心逐层训练的表现超过了端到端训练。3. 表示几何分析显示，非常宽的贪心训练网络具有更高的 SSF 和 SNF，表明类间差异在表征空间中分布更均匀且类内变化相对较小。4. 此外，在 SimCLR 损失和 CIFAR-100 数据集上也观察到了类似的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 网络宽度可以弥补信用分配范围的限制，特别是在较浅的网络中，宽度的增加使得贪心逐层训练能够达到甚至超过端到端反向传播训练的性能。表示几何差异可能是这一现象的原因之一。这些结果支持使用较浅且较宽的网络与局部学习规则作为生物学上更合理的替代方案。

title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
summary: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"嫁接"(grafting)方法，通过在基础模型而非后训练模型上训练SDF适配器，再将学到的权重更新加到后训练模型上，从而在保持能力的同时减少现实漂移和偏好一致性损失，并实现适配器的复用。
AI.motivation: 当前SDF干预通常直接施加于后训练模型，会损害偏好一致性并引发"现实漂移"(模型将无关虚构实体误认为真实)，而将合成文档混入预训练又需重跑昂贵的后训练，因此需要一种快速迭代预训练干预的方法。
AI.method: 嫁接法：在基础模型上训练LoRA适配器(Δ_SDF)，将其直接加到后训练模型上(θ_post + Δ_SDF)，等价于先做中间训练再加现有后训练更新，从而避免SDF与后训练权重直接交互造成的损伤。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B、Llama-3.3-70B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash(284B)、Nemotron Super 120B上验证：嫁接以与原生SDF相当的强度安装目标信念，同时将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失减少过半；同一适配器可复用至所有后续后训练检查点(SFT/DPO/RL)；还成功迁移了涌现失准和宪法中间训练干预的效果。
AI.conclusion: 嫁接是一种廉价且忠实的预训练干预迭代方案，单个适配器可在多个后训练检查点间复用，在假事实、模型生物和对齐干预中均有效，但仍存在表达-损伤权衡、有限后训练、需在匹配表达强度下比较等局限。

title: Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于线性理论的合成数据选择方法TATC（Training-Aware Target Coverage），用于LLM微调中的合成数据选择。该方法同时考虑输入的覆盖度和合成响应引入的训练误差，通过小型标记真实探针集评估候选样本的训练效果，并选择能扩展目标相关方向覆盖度的样本。在GSM8K数学推理任务上微调Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct时，TATC在各种选择预算下均优于现有合成数据选择方法。
AI.motivation: 合成数据虽然能大规模扩展LLM训练，但并非越多越好——冗余样本信息量有限，含错误的样本甚至会降低性能。现有方法（基于质量、多样性、梯度相似性等）分别捕获有用数据的不同方面，但未能回答：合成样本如何贡献于既有训练集并影响目标任务？一个样本可能增加欠表示区域的输入信息，但其生成响应可能同时引入有害训练效应；反之，训练效应有利的样本，若其特征区域已被充分表示，则增加的信息有限。因此需要一种联合考虑训练效应和边际信息贡献的选择方法。
AI.method:
1. **线性理论框架**：在下游二次风险定义下，将合成集的价值分解为信息增益G_info、随机噪声成本C_noise和系统偏差成本C_bias三项的差。分析了方向性价值（哪些特征方向有用）、最优合成数据量（多少数据最优）、边际价值（添加一个样本的收益取决于已有数据集）。  
2. **TATC方法**：利用真实数据微调得到的检查点θ₀，提取prompt表征。对每个候选样本计算两个互补得分：  
- h_j（二次训练得分）：评估候选样本在探针集上的预测损失减少，基于AdamW更新差异的局部二次模型  
- a_j(S)（目标覆盖度）：通过Sherman-Morrison公式计算候选输入对目标相关方向的边际覆盖增益  
3. **选择算法**：按h_j降序排列，在每步从前κ·s个候选中选a_j(S)最大的，迭代至预算B。
AI.result:
1. **理论验证**：在SetFit/subj文本数据上，覆盖度得分AUROC仅为0.519，而完整边际得分AUROC达0.99；在CIFAR-10图像数据上，探针估计的有用数据量与测试最优量吻合（Kendall τ=1.00）。  
2. **GSM8K实验**：B=128时，TATC达到87.34%精确匹配，超过最强对手OptimSyn（86.07%）和TATC(Coverage)消融（85.19%），消融差距2.15分；在B=512时差距扩大至2.99分。在预算64、64、256时均优于OptimSyn，B=512时两者均值实际持平。
AI.conclusion: 本文为合成数据选择提供了原则性方法，通过量化和最大化其对目标任务的价值。线性理论揭示了合成数据的价值具有方向性、数量依赖性和边际性——同一个样本可以是增值的、冗余的或有害的，取决于现有数据和错误的存在。TATC将这一洞察转化为实用的选择方法，在LLM微调中联合考虑训练效应和目标覆盖度，推动合成数据流水线从孤立评估转向考虑数据上下文和下游任务。

title: On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D
comment: Published (Spotlight) at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"即时权重生成"框架，使用超网络从少量示例直接生成紧凑专用模型的完整参数，并在ARC-1D测试床上验证其可行性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型可从上下文适应多任务，但专用模型容量更小却需任务特定训练；作者探索能否仅凭少量演示直接生成专用模型参数，从而将任务推断与执行解耦。
AI.method: 采用编码器-解码器超网络：Transformer任务编码器压缩支持集为episode表征，两层MLP权重解码器通过低维瓶颈生成完整目标参数（三层Canon Transformer，含RoPE）。损失在支持集与查询上联合监督，训练中可有/无显式任务ID条件化。
AI.result: 单独训练的1.4K参数小模型可达98.9%准确率，联合训练仅74.0%；超网络生成的专用模型恢复专家性能；生成参数形成按变换组织的结构化权重空间（无任务ID时60.9%线性探针可分）；生成的专家可脱离超网络重复使用；在组合泛化和未见变换的留一法测试中，去除任务ID显著提升迁移能力（组合token精度+7.8%，未见token精度+13.4%，未见精确匹配+8.85%）。
AI.conclusion: 证明了从少量演示即时编译出紧凑可执行模型参数的概念可行性；权重空间具有可结构化、可重用与可泛化的特性；移除显式任务标识符反而提升分布外泛化能力，为模型即工具、即时个性化部署等方向奠定基础。

title: Verbalized and Internal Probabilities Are Coupled in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models carry an internal notion of uncertainty in their sampling distribution, i.e., the probabilities they place on generating one answer rather than another. They can also be asked to state a confidence, in words or as a number: a verbalized uncertainty. Prior work suggests that internal probabilities track relative frequencies in the training data, and that verbalized probabilities track explicit probabilistic assertions in the training data. However, we do not know whether these two readouts are aligned, except when frequencies and probabilistic assertions in the training data happen to align. This limits our understanding of when we can use verbalized uncertainties as a proxy for either training data frequencies, or a model's internal distribution. We resolve this gap by systematically exploring how LLMs probability readouts are impacted by training and in-context data, via intervening on the underlying uncertainty sources in the data. We find that both internal and verbalized probability readouts are impacted by both distributional and asserted uncertainty in the training data. Further, we find that verbalized and internal probabilities are aligned beyond what would be expected by independently tracking the same uncertainty sources, suggesting that verbalized probabilities can be used to probe a model's internal distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大语言模型(LLM)中"内部概率"(从采样分布/logits提取)与"口头化概率"(让模型用语言表达置信度)之间的关系。通过合成数据干预实验发现,这两种不确定性读出并非独立通道,而是来自共享的内部表征,均可被训练数据中的频率型不确定性(frequency-based)和断言型不确定性(assertion-based)所影响。研究证实口头化概率可作为内部概率的有效代理。
AI.motivation: 现有研究分别表明LLM的内部概率跟踪训练数据的相对频率,口头化概率跟踪训练数据中的显式概率断言,但两者是否对齐——以及能否用口头化概率作为内部概率或训练数据频率的代理——尚未明确。这一空白限制了对LLM不确定性读出机制的理解,也影响如何正确使用口头化不确定性。
AI.method: 采用受控干预实验设计:(1)在合成词汇上从头训练小型GPT-2风格transformer,设置三类实体集(仅频率、仅断言、配对),检验能否跨通道学习不确定性;(2)构建虚构人物数据集(Fictional Occupation和Fictional Country),通过LoRA、全量微调(FFT)和上下文学习(ICL)三种方式注入四种不确定性来源(频率/断言 × 简洁/详细),使用Lin's CCC和偏Pearson相关度量对齐程度。涉及21个开源LLM,涵盖Qwen3、Qwen2.5、Gemma-2、OLMo-2四个系列,0.5B–32B规模。
AI.result: 核心发现包括:(1)口头化概率确实能反映训练数据或上下文中的相对频率(RQ1肯定);(2)训练数据中的概率断言会同时影响口头化和内部概率读出,且对相关但无关属性的概率也会产生"置信度泄漏"(如对职业的断言会影响左右撇子属性)(RQ2肯定);(3)在控制目标概率后,口头化与内部概率仍存在显著偏相关,表明二者共享潜在表征而非独立跟踪同一信号(RQ3肯定);(4)当两种不确定性源混合时,ICL设置中口头化/内部读出更快地倾向于断言型信号,而训练设置中频率型信号更稳健。
AI.conclusion: LLM的口头化概率和内部概率并非两个独立通道,而是耦合于共享的内部不确定性表征。这验证了使用口头化概率作为内部不确定性代理的合理性,也为改进模型校准提供了新途径(例如用校准良好的断言改进采样校准)。但同时也揭示了新的可靠性风险:训练数据中失准的概率断言不仅影响口头化概率,还影响采样分布和行为,且置信度可能泄漏到无关属性。局限性包括实验主要依赖合成数据、不确定性的频率/断言分离在真实数据中可能不存在、以及仅探究二元结果的不确定性。

title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

AI.tldr: SHARPO是一种用于智能体强化学习的信用分配机制，通过在交互段层级上利用组内成功rollout构建教师上下文，计算师生对数概率间隙衡量参数间的局部反馈，并以此产生GRPO优势的有界乘数，从而在稀疏终端奖励下对中间决策进行差异化信用分配。
AI.motivation: 在多轮交互任务中，最终结果仅提供稀疏的轨迹级奖励信号，无法区分导致成功的有用中间动作和造成失败的局部错误动作，这导致了智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题。
AI.method: SHARPO包含五个步骤：1)识别交互段（动作或推理）；2)从同一GRPO组内选择一个成功rollout构建教师上下文；4)教师是策略参数的副本，评估学生的师生对数概率间隙；5)用sigmoid函数将间隙映射为有界权重w；6)经过长度平衡后，插值计算段级优势，以此最大化策略目标。理论上证明了与终身胜负参考具有相同符号的方向性与相近局部价值的一致性。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，SHARPO在ALFWorld和WebShop上均优于GRPO、SDAR、RLSD和StepOPSD，ALFWorld从70.57%提升至84.90%，WebShop从66.15%提升至75.26%。在多个ALFWorld任务类型和WebShop任务得分上均有提升，且对混合权重λ的取值不敏感。
AI.conclusion: SHARPO利用成功对端反馈在中间交互段上细化GRPO信用，为智能体训练提供了一种有效的段级信用分配方法，通过理论分析和实验结果证明了其在多轮交互任务中的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Contextual trajectory and incremental contextual displacement: Towards using LLMs to understand dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as RoBERTa represent text using contextual word embeddings (CWEs), which alter the embeddings associated with each token based on surrounding context. We construct token-wise incremental trajectories by repeatedly recomputing a token's CWE as successive words are added to a sentence, yielding a representation of how contextualized embeddings evolve as the utterance unfolds. We evaluate this approach using garden-path sentences as a test case with characteristic features. Token-wise trajectories reproduce known features of garden-path processing, including disruption around the critical region, and reliably distinguish garden-path sentences from matched disambiguated controls. We introduce several metrics for quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments and show that trajectory information can be highly predictive of sentence type. We find that ambiguity-related information is recoverable not only from the sentence-level CLS representation but also from ordinary vocabulary tokens, suggesting that utterance-level information is distributed across multiple representational scales. In exploratory analyses, we find qualitatively similar trajectory structures in other ambiguity- and misdirection-related linguistic phenomena. Together, these results establish token-wise incremental trajectories as a promising framework for studying utterance-specific meaning construction using LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"token-wise incremental trajectory"（逐标记增量轨迹）方法，通过逐步增加上下文并反复重新计算token的上下文嵌入（CWE），将LLM对句子的处理表征为嵌入空间中的动态路径。以garden-path句为案例验证，发现garden-path句的增量轨迹在歧义区域呈现特征性的"U-turn"扰动，分类器能以约98.5%准确率区分garden-path句与其消歧对照，轨迹顺序打乱后性能骤降至56%，表明信息确实编码在轨迹的有序结构中。此外，歧义相关信息不仅存在于CLS token中，也可从普通词汇token（首词token的分类准确率约97.8%）的轨迹中恢复，提示话语级信息在LLM中呈多尺度分布。在"dad jokes"等多尺度歧义/误导现象中也观察到类似的"U-turn"轨迹结构。
AI.motivation: LLM的内部表示为研究话语特定的、动态的意义构建提供了前所未有的定量工具，但现有方法多关注静态或粗粒度的语义表征。本文旨在开发一种基于CWE逐步演化的轨迹表示，用以捕捉人类语言处理中增量的、上下文驱动的意义构建过程，并以garden-path句作为具有已知心理语言学特征的可验证测试案例。
AI.method: 使用RoBERTa（辅以DeBERTa、DistilBERT）作为编码器。对长度为N的句子，进行N次独立前向传播，每次在递增的上下文上重新计算所有token的CWE，构造每个token在嵌入空间中的轨迹。提出四种轨迹算子D1-D2（逐增量位移的L2范数或向量差）和D3-D4（相对于初始嵌入的总位移）。定义四个度量：gross turbulence（总湍流）、net turbulence（净湍流）、stability（稳定性=净/总）和inverse normalized stability（逆归一化稳定性）。用1D-CNN（辅以FFNN）对garden-path句vs消歧句进行二分类，并通过随机打乱轨迹序测试有序结构的重要性。PCA/UMAP用于可视化。探索性分析了"dad jokes"和含多义词"run"的四种句型。
AI.result: （i）Garden-path句的轨迹在临界区域出现最大的语义间隙（"U-turn"），与Jurayj et al.(2022)的发现一致；（ii）1D-CNN分类器在CLS轨迹上达到验证准确率约98.5%、holdout（跨数据集测试）准确率约99.8%；打乱轨迹后骤降至约56%，说明依赖有序结构；（iii）首词token的轨迹分类验证准确率约97.8%、holdout约99.7%，表明话语级信息并非仅存在于CLS中；临界区首词轨迹验证准确率约94.8%但holdout仅约54.9%（因数据集句长差异大）；倒数第二token的差向量分类接近随机；（iv）Garden-path句与消歧句在inverse normalized stability分布上有统计学显著差异（KS检验p=0.0207）；（v）多义词"run"的多义词义项预测准确率约85.4%；CLS按句型聚类，目标token"run"在第3-4主成分中显现更多按词义组织；（vi）Dad jokes的平均轨迹呈现与garden-path句相似的全局"U"形；（vii）RoBERTa、DeBERTa、DistilBERT在garden-path处理上呈现定性一致的曲线，但OLMo轨迹对齐较差（可能因更大嵌入空间与不同注意力机制）。
AI.conclusion: 逐token增量轨迹是研究LLM中话语特定意义构建的一个有前景的框架。它重现了garden-path处理的已知特征，能可靠地区分garden-path与消歧句，并表明歧义相关信息在多个表征尺度上分布，不局限于专门的句级表示（CLS）。这种动态轨迹视角或可推广至更广泛的歧义与误导现象（如笑话），为理解LLM内部表征如何组织局部词汇信息与全局话语信息提供了新工具。未来工作需在更多模型和更长语篇上验证，并探索子句级和跨架构的表征对应关系。

title: Don't Waste the Noise: Importance-Guided Perturbation Allocation under Joint Global and Local Constraints
summary: Adversarial optimization under a shared $\ell_1$ budget requires deciding not only how much perturbation to use, but also where that limited budget should be spent. This allocation problem becomes particularly important when individual input coordinates are subject to local magnitude constraints, which restrict the extent to which perturbation can be concentrated on a small number of locations. We introduce an importance-guided allocation mechanism that uses a fixed clean-gradient prior to steer perturbation toward model-sensitive regions while leaving the feasible perturbation set unchanged. A centered allocation objective encourages perturbation at above-average importance locations and discourages unnecessary expenditure elsewhere, thereby redistributing rather than enlarging the available budget. Across ten robust model--dataset configurations under a common capacity-limited threat setting, the proposed method improves attack success over matched APGD- and PMA-based baselines by $2.52$ to $17.70$ percentage points. Allocation analysis shows that these gains are accompanied by substantially greater perturbation mass in high-importance regions without increased global $\ell_1$ consumption. Mechanism ablations further show that centered non-uniform redistribution provides part of the benefit, while model-derived importance yields an additional improvement. These results identify perturbation allocation as a distinct and practically relevant dimension of adversarial optimization under shared-budget, locally constrained threat models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于重要性引导的稳健性分配机制，用于在共享ℓ₁全局预算和坐标级局部容量约束下的对抗优化。核心思想是分离扰动的可行性（feasibility）与分配偏好（allocation preference）：通过固定的清洁梯度先验构造中心化的重要性图，引导扰动集中于高重要性位置，但不改变可行扰动集。在十个鲁棒模型-数据集配置上，相对匹配基线ASR提升2.52-17.70个百分点。消融实验证实中心化非均匀重分配与模型重要性对齐分别贡献了改进。
AI.motivation: 在共享ℓ₁预算与坐标级局部容量约束下，对抗优化不仅需要决定扰动量的大小，还需决定有限预算的分配位置。已有ℓ₁攻击（如ℓ₁-APGD）能够集中扰动到少数位置，但当这些位置达到局部容量上限后，剩余预算必须分配到其他可行坐标，此时缺乏明确的分配引导机制。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 威胁模型：可行集C(x,E,b)由全局均值ℓ₁预算（b=4/255）、坐标级异质局部容量（μE=12/255，σE=2/255）和图像范围约束[0,1]^D共同定义；(2) 清洁梯度重要性先验：从真实类别logit的梯度构造空间重要性图，经分位数裁剪、均值归一化、幂函数（γ=1.0）变换和clip截断[0.05, 8.0]处理；(3) 中心化分配目标：R_alloc(δ,M)=(1/(Db))∑(Mᵢ-1)√(δᵢ²+τ²)，通过Mᵢ-1实现高于均值的奖励、低于均值的惩罚。优化采用动量梯度法（μ=0.75）、余弦衰减步长、顺序可行性恢复（局部裁剪→图像范围→ℓ₁球投影），候选选择基于概率边际。
AI.result: 在十个鲁棒模型-数据集配置（CIFAR-10/100的WRN、XCiT模型；ImageNet的ConvNeXt-L、ViT-B-ConvStem、Swin-L等）上，本文方法相对APGD-CE、APGD-DLR和PMA匹配基线的ASR提升2.52-17.70个百分点（ImageNet/Peng et al.提升最大）。分配分析显示：基线在高重要性10%空间位置上放置约10.6-11.3%的扰动质量（接近均匀），而本文方法提升至19.15-30.36%。实现全局ℓ₁预算（≈3.91-3.97/255 vs 4.0）。消融实验表明：无分配指导时ASR下降9.4-14.0百分点；非中心化变体性能下降；随机掩码相比无掩码仍提升4.0-5.2百分点（证实非均匀重分配自身有益）；模型先验提供额外提升。所有30个配对比较p_Holm值均<10⁻¹⁸，统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究确认扰动分配是共享预算局部约束威胁模型下一个独立且实用的优化维度。中心化重要性引导分配通过在不改变可行集的前提下引导优化偏好，能显著提升匹配对抗优化器性能。该机制可推广至多种对抗损失（cross-entropy、margin、DLR、probability margin），且在均匀容量设置下同样有效。但本文未声称对专门ℓ₁攻击（如ℓ₁-APGD、FMN-ℓ₁）的普遍优越性——这些攻击在参考比较中仍更强。重要性图基于清洁梯度，未来可研究动态或学习型分配信号；λ按数据集在独立校准集上选择并在模型间冻结。

title: Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting
summary: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

AI.tldr: 针对协变量偏移下表格数据稀缺与不平衡问题，提出IGDPR框架，通过不变性引导的潜在扩散模型合成任务相关数据，并结合基于原型的结构化重加权策略，在四个工业基准数据集上实现最优性能。
AI.motivation: 工业表格数据面临协变量偏移问题，现有数据增强和重加权方法存在两大缺陷：生成模型仅模仿过时的源分布（误导性生成引导），点式重加权方法过拟合验证噪声（结构不稳定性）。
AI.method: 1）任务不变VAE（TI-VAE）通过多环境风险方差惩罚构建不变潜在空间；2）不变性引导的潜在扩散模型在反向去噪时利用冻结TI-VAE的任务、密度、重建信号作为奖励梯度引导生成；3）原型重加权在不变潜在空间进行K-Means聚类，以簇级别可靠性评分（任务+不变性损失与密度损失的综合函数）分配样本权重。
AI.result: 在C-MAPSS、MetroPT-3、Scania APS、Gas Sensor四个工业数据集上，IGDPR（Guided Latent Diffusion + Prototype）综合所有指标均达到最优；消融实验验证两模块协同性；信息平面分析显示域信息I(Z;E)降低35–65%，任务信息I(Z;Y)提升40–200%；超参数β≈1.0、γ∈[0.5,1.0]存在宽性能平台。
AI.conclusion: 不变性是目标监督不可用时的有效替代目标，可在协变量偏移下统一生成与重加权；未来方向包括无需先验结构的不变性发现、流式环境中的漂移域定义以及端到端不变子空间学习。

title: FORALL-LEAN-AGENT for Auditable Reasoning in Formal Mathematics and Software Verification
summary: Coding agents increasingly automate Lean proof development, but successful compilation alone does not establish that a candidate proves the intended statement under acceptable assumptions. We present FORALL-LEAN-AGENT, a frontend-agnostic framework for auditable reasoning in formal mathematics and software verification. The framework combines isolated workspaces, Lean tools, and fresh review with statement comparison, axiom audits, and independent proof checking where supported. Verification evidence and reviewer decisions are bound to the same candidate artifact, making acceptance traceable. We evaluate the framework on VeriSoftBench, PutnamBench, and both problems in the Lean Eval softwareverification track. On the 100-task VeriSoftBench subset, integration with FORALLLEAN-AGENT raises benchmark-rule success from 93 to 100 for GPT-5.6 Sol at low effort while reducing cost from $69 to $62. The PutnamBench evaluation accepts all 672 problems at an average of $4.72 each. These results show that agent harness design can improve correctness and efficiency while providing evidence beyond aggregate solve counts.

AI.tldr: FORALL-LEAN-AGENT is a frontend-agnostic framework for auditable Lean proof development that combines persistent actor sessions, fresh reviewer sessions, isolated workspaces with runtime access controls, statement-comparison and axiom audits, and digest-bound acceptance to ensure that accepted candidate artifacts genuinely prove the intended statements. Evaluated on VeriSoftBench (100-task subset), PutnamBench (672 problems), and Lean Eval software verification, it improves benchmark-rule success and reduces cost in matched comparisons while accepting all 672 PutnamBench problems at $4.72 each and validating both Lean Eval developments through the trusted comparator and nanoda kernel.
AI.motivation: Successful Lean elaboration does not by itself guarantee that an agent preserved the intended statement, avoided reference solutions, or submitted the same artifact reviewed. Coding agents with filesystem, shell, and network access can bypass prompts and inflate benchmarks. The motivation is to provide auditable execution and acceptance protocols that tie verified artifacts, reviewer approval, and reviewer/compiler evidence to a single digest while enforcing runtime blindness.
AI.method: The framework uses isolated task workspaces with shell sandboxing or tool/path restrictions and a provider-only network proxy. Forall-Lean-MCP provides statement-only retrieval (lookup, search, usages, outline) so navigation does not leak proof bodies. An adapter layer separates coding-agent sessions (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode) from benchmark adapters. A layered verifier checks preserved frozen statement, no name shadowing, no admission or disallowed kernel mechanisms, kernel elaboration, and permitted axioms via #print axioms. A fresh reviewer session with read-only access and no actor transcript recompiles the candidate and checks statement weakening, altered answers, vacuous or circular constructions. Acceptance requires verifier pass and reviewer approval on the same SHA-256 digest, with HMAC-bound resumable state. Lean Eval additionally uses the pinned comparator, lean4export, and the independent nanoda kernel; VeriSoftBench reports independent-checker coverage separately. Serial re-verification against clean repositories and reference-similarity screening support audit.
AI.result: On the 100-task VeriSoftBench-Aristotle subset, FORALL-LEAN-AGENT + Codex/GPT-5.6 Sol at low effort raises benchmark-rule success from 93 to 100 while reducing cost from $69 to $62, and at xhigh reaches 100 (initial 96). With Opus 5 at low effort it improves the unaided count from 99 to 100 and strict successes from 87 to 89 at $118 versus $135 for unaided xhigh. With Opus 5 at xhigh it reaches 100 and 96 strict successes at $111 versus $135. The unaided Codex with OpenCode solves 67–70 tasks versus 100 with Codex frontend, and per-task cost falls to about $0.33. On PutnamBench all 672 problems are accepted at an average of $4.72 each (median actor cost $2.49, mean $3.52, reviewer $1.20), median 27 minutes wall time, median 7 compilations, 662 accepted on first review and 651 with no continuation. Lean Eval standardizes both problems (coc_strong_normalization: 233 files/~28.6k lines; rcf_quantifier_elimination: 1 file/~1.5k lines), both passing comparator and independent-kernel checks. Threats identified include permission bypass, unrestricted network exposure, filesystem search alternatives, leftover originals replacing submitted artifacts (5/97), and 229 false failure records from authentication/usage errors; controls are detailed. Performance varies by frontend and configuration.
AI.conclusion: FORALL-LEAN-AGENT demonstrates that agent harness design materially affects measured correctness and efficiency, and that auditable acceptance tied to specific artifacts and reviewer approval provides evidence beyond aggregate solve counts. The framework supports auditable Lean reasoning across formal mathematics (PutnamBench) and software verification (VeriSoftBench, Lean Eval). The work is descriptive rather than ablated; gains depend on configuration; results on the 100-task subset do not extrapolate to all 500 VeriSoftBench tasks; the reviewer shares the actor model family; and runtime restrictions plus similarity audits cannot rule out training-data exposure, motivating temporal holdouts and withheld solutions for stronger contamination studies.

title: Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对冻结推理模型进行轻量级后训练来构建多令牌预测(MTP)头，仅需约2.5B训练token即可达到或超过联合预训练基线(如MiMo-7B)的吞吐量加速；同时提出链感知近似验证规则和自适应K值控制器，进一步优化MTP推理系统的吞吐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开源MTP家族(MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3)均需在完整预训练过程中(数万亿token)联合训练MTP头，drafter质量在预训练阶段就被锁定。本文质疑联合预训练是否是MTP高质量的必要条件，探索在冻结骨干模型上进行轻量级后训练构建MTP头的可能性，并优化相应的推理服务系统。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1)在冻结Qwen3-8B上使用自蒸馏(目标生成的思维链数据)进行交叉熵后训练，训练3个链式MTP头，每头约200M参数；(2)提出链感知近似验证规则(Eq1)，用链的运行几何平均概率阈值τ代替严格逐位置分布匹配，允许有界分布漂移；(3)提出在线Lower Confidence Bound(LCB)bandit控制器，动态选择MTP draft depth(K=1..6)，根据批量大小和文本难度优化吞吐量。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH500、AIME24/25数学推理及MMLU-Redux、MBPP、MT-Bench、Alpaca、CNN/DailyMail等基准上：(1)后训练MTP头在MAL上达到或超过MiMo-7B，训练token减少10^3-10^4倍；(2)链感知验证在数学基准上平均提升MAL达+14%(从2.91到3.31)，任务准确率保持；(3)自适应控制器在高批量(bs=64/128)下恢复固定K=6损失的11-14%吞吐量，相对K=3达97-99%。自适应Mamba选择器策略可产生额外约4%的MAL提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：在目标生成思维链数据上的轻量后训练可替代MTP头的联合预训练，计算效率提升10^3-10^4倍；链感知验证松弛在保持准确率前提下显著提升推理吞吐；自适应K值bandit解决了固定draft depth在高批量场景下的吞吐量崩溃。这套方案使MTP成为推理时可插拔的优化层，无需重新预训练骨干模型。

title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
summary: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Kimi K2.7 Code（1T 参数 MoE 模型）仅使用 1,700 个专家构建的编码任务进行一轮 GSPO + rank-32 LoRA 的强化学习后训练，在六个外部基准（含四个训练数据收集后才发布的基准和两个训练中未使用过的智能体框架）上全部取得 pass@1 提升（4.7–20.0 pp），并通过配对轨迹分析揭示所迁移的是"完成工作的方式"（理解需求、测试需求、保护既有行为、重建真值），而非领域知识本身。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 编码智能体训练后的评估多在与训练数据同分布的格式上进行，难以区分模型学到的是领域知识还是"完成任务的一般能力"。本文旨在回答：仅在专家级智能体编码任务上做 RL，学到的东西能否跨基准、跨智能体框架、跨时间跨度迁移？即"完成工作的方式"是否可迁移？
AI.method: （1）数据：1,700 个专家构建任务（1,000 仓库任务 + 700 终端任务），均与六个评估基准无重叠；（2）奖励：部分信用（通过的检查比例）× pass-to-pass 测试硬门控（任一回归即零奖励）；（3）优化器：GSPO（序列级比率，适配 MoE）+ rank-32 LoRA 适配器，无 KL、无 SFT 预热、无熵奖励；（4）评估：六个外部基准 × 三个框架（mini-swe-agent、Terminus 2、Claude Code），其中四个基准晚于训练数据；（6）统计：Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel、Boschloo 精确检验。
AI.result: 六个基准全部提升：SWE-Bench Pro 60.1→64.8、DeepSWE 31.0→43.4、Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.4→82.0、Terminal-Bench 3 1.4→12.1、Terminal-Bench 4 0.0→7.6、SWE-Marathon 5.0→25.0；五个独立 task set 合并 p<0.001；训练后发布的三个 task set 合并 p=0.004；DeepSWE 与 Terminal-Bench 3 中位步数减少 24–35%；83% 的基础模型 DeepSWE 失败为近失（missed）；配对分析识别四种失败模式（遗漏需求、窄测试、静默回归、弱真值）及其被纠正后的行为。
AI.conclusion: 在 1,700 专家编码任务上仅做一轮 RL 即可在六个评估基准、三种框架（含两个训练未见框架）、多小时时间跨度和训练后发布的数据上稳定迁移；迁移的内容不是基础模型已具备的领域知识，而是一种"完整完成工作的工程习惯"——将规范视为合同、将自身工作视为待检验的假设。

title: Understanding Issues, Causes and Solutions in Open-Source LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 30 pages, 4 images, 10 tables, Manuscript submitted to a journal (2026)
summary: With the advancement of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), an increasing number of opensource projects are adopting multi-agent architectures as the foundation of their core functionality. Although research and practice on MAS have attracted considerable attention, limited studies have explored the challenges faced by practitioners of open-source LLM-based MAS, the causes of these challenges, and potential solutions. To address this gap,we conducted an empirical study to understand the issues that practitioners encounter when developing and using open-source LLM-based MAS, the possible causes of these issues, and potential solutions. We collected 22,848 closed issues from 21 open-source LLM-basedMASand applied a mixed automated and manual filtering approach to reduce the dataset to 944 issues related to LLM-based this http URL then analyzed these issues to understand the frequent issues encountered by practitioners, their underlying causes, and potential solutions. Our study results show that (1) Orchestration & Execution Issue is the most common issue faced by practitioners, (2) Workflow Problem, Tool Integration Problem, and Memory Problem are identified as the most frequent causes of the issues, and (3) Optimize Workflow is the predominant solution to the issues. Based on the study results, we derive empirically grounded implications for practitioners and researchers aimed at improving orchestration, tool integration, and memory mechanisms in LLM-based MAS.

AI.tldr: 本文对21个开源LLM多智能体系统项目的22,848个已关闭GitHub issue进行实证分析，经过筛选后得到944个MAS相关issue。研究构建了问题、根因和解决方案的三层分类法，并建立了问题-根因、问题-解决方案的映射关系。主要发现：编排与执行问题最常见（22.0%）；工作流问题（29.4%）、工具集成问题（11.7%）和记忆问题（11.1%）是最高频的根因；优化工作流（26.0%）是最主要的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM多智能体系统（MAS）的快速发展，越来越多的开源项目采用多智能体架构作为核心功能。然而，关于开发者在开发和维护MAS时所面临的实际挑战、问题的成因和解决方案的实证研究十分有限。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过分析GitHub上的已关闭issue来理解LLM-based MAS开发和使用中的实际问题。
AI.method: 研究采用混合方法（自动+手动）的实证研究方法：(1) 从GitHub收集21个开源LLM-based MAS项目的22,848个已关闭issue，筛选标准包括star数≥3000、贡献者≥10、closed issue≥100、近一年内更新过等；(2) 使用DeepSeek-R1本地部署进行自动过滤，结合第一作者和第二作者手动复核（Cohen's Kappa=0.82），最终保留944个MAS相关issue；(4) 手动提取问题（issue）、根因（cause）、解决方案（solution）三类信息；(6) 使用开放编码（Open Coding）和持续比较（Constant Comparison）方法进行扎根理论分析，最终分别建立包含17类问题、14类根因、10类解决方案的分类法，并构建问题-根因、问题-解决方案的映射关系。
AI.result: 1. 问题（RQ1）：编排与执行问题最常见（22.0%），其次是记忆与状态管理问题（14.7%）、功能请求（13.2%）、实现问题（10.6%）、工具问题（9.2%）。共17个问题类别。2. 根因（RQ2）：工作流问题最高频（29.4%），其次是工具集成问题（11.7%）、记忆问题（11.1%）、集成问题（10.4%）、代理生命周期问题（10.4%）。共14个根因类别。3. 解决方案（RQ3）：优化工作流最主要（26.0%），其次是调整配置（15.0%）、优化工具集成（11.9%）、优化基础设施（11.0%）。共10个解决方案类别。4. 映射表明：编排问题57%由工作流问题引起；记忆问题51.2%由记忆问题引起；工具问题35.9%由工具集成问题引起。文档问题解决率最高（76.9%），输出问题解决率最低（24.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 本文是第一篇同时建立开源LLM-based MAS问题、根因和解决方案三层分类法并构建其映射关系的实证研究。主要结论：(1) 编排与执行问题是LLM-based MAS面临的最关键挑战；(2) 工作流问题是最主要的根因；(3) 优化工作流是最普遍的解决方案。文章为用户、开发者、研究者分别提供了启示：用户应关注提示工程和显式交接设计；开发者需要具备多智能体设计知识并加强工具集成验证；研究者应探索编排框架、问题复现方法和可靠记忆机制。研究的主要贡献包括数据集公开发布、三层分类法和映射关系，以及对MAS实践的实证指导。

title: The Geometry of Contextual Relations: Language Models Address Facts by Order of Mention
summary: Human reasoning depends on how objects are related within propositions. \textit{How do relations organize the language representations of contextual contents?} We give an LLM a list of facts in its context (e.g., \emph{Alice eats an apple. Bob eats a pear.}) and measure how its hidden state changes when the question switches from what Alice eats to what Bob eats. Averaged over many lists, this change is a steering vector, which we call the \emph{ordinal vector}. It points to a fact by its \emph{order of mention}, the order in which the facts were stated in the context. We find that LLMs represent the fact a question asks about by its order of mention, not by the name the question contains. We state this as the \textit{ordinal addressing hypothesis}: each order of mention has a \emph{fact address} in the model's state, shared by all contexts, and a question moves the state to the fact address of the fact it asks about, while the context supplies what that fact says. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Llama, fact addresses are (1) \emph{ordered by mention}: query states are organized by the order of facts, not of names, even when one fact has multiple subjects; (2) \emph{steerable}: added to a question about the first fact of a new list, the ordinal vector makes the model answer with the second fact of that list; (3) \emph{low-rank}: they span a low-rank subspace in which the first-mentioned fact is the easiest to reach, surprisingly similar to human recall; and (4) \emph{emergent}: they are shared in late-middle layers, hold from 1.5B to 32B parameters, and form early in pretraining. Language models reach a stated fact by where it was mentioned, deepening our understanding of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）如何处理上下文中的关系型事实，提出并验证了"序数寻址假设"（Ordinal Addressing Hypothesis）：LLM根据事实被提及的顺序而非问题中提到的名字来定位事实，即每个提及顺序在模型隐藏状态中对应一个跨上下文共享的"向量"地址，问题的提问将状态移动到相应事实地址，上下文则提供该地址处陈述的内容。
AI.motivation: 人类推理依赖命题中对象之间的语义角色关系（例如"谁爱谁"）。当LLM需要从上下文中检索关系型事实时，它究竟是根据名称还是陈述顺序来寻找事实尚不清楚。探明LLM如何组织上下文内容的语言表征是理解LLM推理的关键。
AI.method: （1）构造事实列表（如"Alice eats an apple. Bob eats a pear."），测量当问题从Alice切换到Bob时LLM隐藏状态的变化；（3）在多个校准上下文上平均该变化向量，定义为"序数向量"（Ordinal Vector）；（2）提出序数寻址假设的形式化定义与推论，包括不变性/反转性、按提及顺序组织、可跨上下文迁移性、线性/低秩子空间等数学性质；（4）通过激活干预（steering）和供体状态替换实验，在Qwen、Gemma、Llama等多个模型上进行验证，并分析其与人类序数记忆的相似性、规模泛化性、训练过程中的形成阶段。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Gemma、Llama系列模型（含1.5B至32B参数）上验证了序数寻址假设的四个核心性质：（1）事实地址按提及顺序而非姓名组织，即使一个事实有两个主语，查询状态仍按事实而非名字对齐（Qwen 99.2%，Gemma/Llama 96.2%）；（2）序数向量可跨上下文迁移：在新上下文加入该向量可成功选中目标事实（Qwen 84.1%，Gemma 53.9%，Llama 36.2%）；（3）事实地址位于低秩子空间（维度≤n-1），后续事实的地址相互拥挤，首位事实最易触及，与人类序列回忆中"首位效应"一致；（4）该地址共享于深中部层窗口中（约64%-86%相对深度），且在预训练早期即出现。
AI.conclusion: LLM通过陈述顺序来定位上下文中的事实，而非通过问题中所包含的名称。序数寻址将上下文结构与内容分离：一个跨所有上下文共享的地址（计数事实而非token）配合上下文提供内容。该结构从纯下一词预测目标中自发涌现，无需显式监督。LLM表现出与人类序数记忆惊人相似的"首位偏好"和"中段拥挤"现象，深化了对LLM如何执行关系型推理的理解。

title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
summary: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReHoPER（Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning），一种零样本推理方法，通过多路径生成并回答中间问题来提升大语言模型推理能力，并在新提出的iLLC受控组合推理基准上进行了系统验证。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在多步组合推理任务中表现不足，且现有推理增强方法（如ToT、Self-Ask、Self-Discover）通常依赖标注数据或任务特定提示设计。论文旨在提出一种无需标注数据、跨任务通用的推理增强方法。
AI.method: ReHoPER采用滚动时域规划策略，运行n条随机推理路径，每条路径迭代执行：1）规划——生成h个候选问题；3）选择——选取第一个未问过的问题；4）回答——回答该问题并更新历史；5）预测——基于当前历史预测最终答案。通过多数投票聚合所有预测结果。关键设计是"先看后行再重规划"的闭环，允许根据已获得的中间答案修订后续规划。
AI.result: 在MuSR、MoreHopQA和iLLC三个基准上，ReHoPER在多数设置下优于Self-Consistency和Self-Discover基线。平均提升：IO +5.8pp，CoT +8.4pp，PS +6.4pp。在最困难的组合设置（iLLC L2-w）上增益最大（PS下+20.9pp）。消融实验证实重规划与前瞻机制均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: ReHoPER是一种有效的零样本推理增强手段，在保持任务无关性的同时显著提升组合推理任务表现，且在更难任务上增益更大。未来可探索自适应计算预算分配。

title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
summary: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models.
