First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GUI-HARVEST 是一个针对 GUI 代理的自动 harness 优化框架，通过证据驱动的诊断、跨任务聚类和可执行代码编辑，使冻结骨干模型的 GUI 代理在 OSWorld-Verified 上取得稳定的留出表现提升。
AI.motivation: GUI 代理的性能严重依赖其外部可执行 harness（观察组装、动作执行、验证、恢复、终止控制）。现有针对非 GUI 代理的通用 harness 优化方法（如 Self-Harness、Meta-Harness）未解决三个 GUI 特有挑战：(1) 模型意图与视觉效果的脱节（如声称保存但对话框仍打开）；(2) 同一任务重复运行结果可变性（11.8–20.4% 的任务在三次执行中出现零分与正分翻转）；(3) 任务特定发现需提炼为可复用 harness 修改，且需验证修改确实针对失败模式。
AI.method: GUI-HARVEST 围绕四个角色形成自改进闭环：(1) Evidence Analyst 将模型输出/动作与前后截图对齐，生成有截图证据支持的 finding；(2) Cross-task Clusterer 将经验证的 finding 按确定性结果类别分组，聚类为跨任务行为模式（行为模式），保留任务本地证据链接；(3) Harness Engineer 将行为模式翻译为有边界的源代码补丁，并预先记录可观察的行为预测；(4) Validator 通过 L0/L1 代码检查、Search/Validation 效用硬门槛（任一分割正增长且无下降）以及基于任务级判定的行为软门槛验证补丁；通过则提升并开启下一轮，否则回滚。优化上限为 B=10 轮，每轮 P=5 次评估机会，Search K=3 次运行。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上（361 任务，80 搜索/80 验证/201 测试），六个冻结骨干模型 15 步全部提升：Qwen3-VL-32B 测试 53.18% (+10.16)、完整套件 50.94% (+12.33)；OpenCUA-32B 测试 34.31% (+1.49)；Gemini 3.1 Pro 100 步达 79.14%；GPT-5 测试 61.86% (+5.51)。同骨干/同初始 harness 起点下，GUI-HARVEST 优于 Self-Harness (+2.00)、Meta-Harness (+4.38)，并在 LFF 的基础上更好。WAA 迁移 50 步 GPT-5 提升 13.87 分（50.88% → 64.75%），无 WAA 优化。消融实验表明视觉证据作用最显著（去掉后全量 40.69%）。GPT-5 在 15 步下准确率达 62.4%，API 成本约 72 美元，相比 Agent S3 100 步 62.6%/260 美元成本降低约 72%。
AI.conclusion: GUI-HARVEST 通过将多次多模态执行证据转化为可复用的 harness 修改并经效用与预测行为双重验证，证明 GUI 特定的诊断和验证机制能让 harness 改进更好地泛化到未见任务。所有六个冻结骨干在 OSWorld-Verified 上均获得留出测试集提升，其学习到的运行时机制可跨平台迁移。残留错误多为动作执行成功但目标错误、路线错误或评估相关状态错误的情况，此类轨迹缺乏明确的本地信号，使 harness 单独修正难度加大。

title: Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning
summary: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. Empirically, SaCRL recovers the true structure on synthetic and semi-synthetic Bayesian-network benchmarks, outperforms fixed-invariance baselines on Colored MNIST, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three DomainBed benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome), and degrades gracefully under structural misspecification and limited environment diversity. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: SaCRL提出了一种无需先验因果结构知识的因果表示学习框架,通过HSIC违规度量与SoftMin聚合实现结构自动识别与不变表示的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法存在三难困境:基于结构的方法需已知DAG,分布不变方法强制固定不变性而在结构错配时失效;遗漏架构会丢弃预测信息,且无方法在结构识别不确定时给出理论保证。
AI.method: 1) 形式化三种典型因果结构(反因果𝒢₁、混淆后代𝒢₂、混淆结果𝒢₃)及其对应不变性约束;2) 用HSIC及其条件形式量化各候选不变性的违规程度Vₖ;3) 通过SoftMin聚合(自适应权重αₖ)将离散结构搜索松弛为连续优化;4) 用随机傅里叶特征(RFF)近似HSIC以降低计算复杂度;5) ERM热启动+温度退火+多起点初始化优化策略。
AI.result: 在合成数据上n=5000时结构识别准确率≥95%;半合成贝叶斯网络基准(ASIA/ALARM/SACHS)上达75-95%;Colored MNIST OOD准确率45.2%(优于ERM 27.2%、IRM 21.3%、CIRCE 10.3%);DomainBed三个基准(PACS/VLCS/OfficeHome)上平均提升+2.1/+4.2/+3.1pp;在结构错配和低环境多样性下优雅退化;识别准确率从n=500的68-78%单调提升到n=5000的95-97%。
AI.conclusion: SaCRL是首个联合识别因果结构并学习对应不变表示的统一端到端可微目标,填补了现有方法的理论空白;提供结构识别(包括RFF近似下)、不变性满足和OOD泛化的理论保证;对临床预测、算法公平、领域泛化等多领域具有应用价值。

title: A Citation-Grounded Benchmark for Trustworthy Earnings Call Transcript Analysis with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used for financial document analysis, including earnings call transcripts (ECTs). Beyond generating standalone claims, users increasingly prefer grounded analyses that pair claims with verifiable citations from source documents to enable independent validation. However, evaluating such analytical claims typically requires extensive expert annotation, which is costly and difficult to scale, and real-world financial analysis commonly involves long context-question-answer triplets, further increasing task complexity. To address these challenges and benchmark the current landscape of grounded analysis by LLMs, we propose a numeric evidence evaluation method that enables groundedness assessment without reliance on expert annotation. We also introduce an automated dataset construction pipeline and construct ECTs-100 from the top 100 constituents of the S&P 500 to support benchmark of both groundedness and correctness. In addition, we examine conscious incompetence, a practical failure mode in financial analysis in which LLMs must detect when available evidence is insufficient and refrain from producing unsupported hallucinations. Empirical results show that LLMs perform well in groundedness but face notable limitations in correctness, with informational insufficiency presenting an additional challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大语言模型在财报电话会议记录（ECTs）分析中的引用支撑能力，提出了一个无需专家标注的数值证据评估方法（NEE）和自动数据集构建流水线，构建了ECTs-100基准，评估了多个基线方法的接地性（groundedness）和正确性（correctness），并探讨了"有意识的无能力"（conscious incompetence）场景下的幻觉问题。实验结果表明，LLM在接地性方面表现良好，但在正确性方面存在显著局限，信息不足构成额外挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在金融文档分析中常产生带有可验证引用的接地分析以增强用户信任，但评估此类声明-引用对需要昂贵的专家注释，难以规模化；此外，真实场景中金融分析多为长上下文问答三元组，进一步增加了任务复杂性。因此需要一个无需专家标注的自动评估方法，以及能够在长上下文设置下同时评估接地性和正确性的基准。
AI.method: 论文提出三大核心方法：(1) 数值证据评估（NEE）方法，通过提取声明、引用和源文档中的显著数值信息（格式为(s, v, t, m)四元组，包含文本片段、标量/区间值、类型和单位），经归一化后进行精确数值匹配（κ⨁），以无监督方式评估接地性，避免依赖LLM作为评判者的偏好偏差；(2) 自动数据集构建流水线，从源文档提取数值→用GPT-4.1为每个数值生成子问题→以原文档中包含该数值的句子作为引用，构建(Q, A_clm, A_cit)三元组，生成来自标普500指数前100成分股的ECTs-100基准；(3) 三层接地性评估（声明-引用、声明-上下文、引用-上下文）结合基于精度/召回率/F1的正确性评估。基线方法包括Vanilla、PostCite和LLMR三种范式，分别采用索引和文本两种引用格式，共六种配置，全部使用GPT-4.1在零样本设置下实现。
AI.result: 接地性方面：所有六种基线方法在声明-上下文接地性（0.970-0.982）和引用-上下文接地性（0.989-0.995）上均表现优异，在声明-引用接地性上存在差异（0.907-0.959），LLMR-text最佳。正确性方面：在ECTs-100上，引用精度高（0.9721）但召回率低（0.7139），引用F1为0.8204；声明归一化召回率0.6658，精度0.6296，F1为0.6468，表明引用准确但声明正确性有待提升。有意识的无能力场景下，当移除支持证据时，平均幻觉率达到0.4834（SE=0.0149），表明信息不足时LLM未能有效拒答而是产生随机数字幻觉。
AI.conclusion: LLM在长上下文问答设置下的引用接地金融分析中表现出可靠的接地性，但在正确性方面存在挑战，且在识别信息不足并避免幻觉方面能力不足。NEE方法、ECTs-100基准和自动数据集构建流水线为可信赖的金融分析研究提供了实用工具，但应注意NEE仅评估数值对齐而非完整语义蕴含，且仅在GPT-4.1单一模型上验证，ECTs-100的参考答案和引用为自动构建。

title: Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TS-Router，一个用于时间序列异常检测（TSAD）的"通用表示 + 专用检测"框架。它利用冻结的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）提取可迁移的时间表征，再由一个轻量路由器根据该表征预测一组异构异常检测器（专用模型）的相对适用性（competence），从而为每个目标序列自适应地选择并组合最合适的检测器。训练阶段无需真实异常标签，通过在有标签的模拟任务上构造软性能力监督信号来训练路由器；部署阶段无需目标异常标签，先路由、再仅对被选中的检测器进行无监督适配与得分融合。
AI.motivation: 异构时间序列具有不同的时序动态和"正常性"概念，单一的异常评分准则难以泛化。现有基于基础模型（TSFM）的 TSAD 方法通常将可迁移表征与固定的预测/重构异常评分耦合，效果往往不如简单的局部统计基线。因此需要重新思考基础模型在 TSAD 中的角色：与其直接定义异常准则，不如让其作为"协调者"，根据序列上下文选择最合适的专用检测器。
AI.method: 1) **合成能力监督**：基于 Syn-RCD 构建大量带标签的模拟任务，将 11 个轻量、异构的无监督异常检测器（覆盖子空间重建、密度、邻域、一类分类、孤立森林、原型距离、谱残差等不同归纳偏置）在模拟任务上评估 VUS-PR 能力，并转化为 softmax 软目标。2) **基础模型引导的能力路由**：冻结 TSFM 编码器（如 TimeRCD、Chronos、MOMENT），取末层 token 嵌入均值池化得到序列级表征 z；训练一个轻量 MLP 路由器 g_θ 将 z 映射为 K 个专用模型的能力分布，以 KL 散度匹配软目标。3) **离线路由与检测（route-before-fit）**：部署时无需目标异常标签，路由器先预测能力并选 Top-k（默认 k=3）专用模型，再对这些被选中模型在目标序列训练前缀上无监督拟合，对其归一化得分进行均值融合和 min-max 缩放作为最终异常得分。4) **理论分析**：在表征覆盖和条件能力稳定假设下，证明了模拟到真实任务的 Top-k 集合能力遗憾上界（Theorem 1），并推导了在边界分离条件下的集合恢复与融合得分一致性（Corollary 1）。
AI.result: 在 16 个真实 TSAD 基准（11 个真正单变量 + 5 个多变量）和 4 种互补评估指标（VUS-PR、Affiliation-F1、F1_T、Standard-F1）上，TS-Router 取得最优的平均排名（Overall Rank 2.66），并在 64 个数据集-指标组合中 26 次第一、39 次进入前二，全面优于直接零样本 TSFM 模型（TimeRCD、DADA、Chronos、MOMENT、TimesFM、Time-MoE）和目标拟合无监督模型（OmniAnomaly、USAD、TranAD、TFMAE、DCdetector）。受控消融显示：(i) Top-3 路由优于 Best Fixed、Best Fixed Top-3、Router Top-1 和 Full Ensemble 等策略；(ii) 三种冻结 TSFM 编码器（TimeRCD/Chronos/MOMENT）作为路由器输入均优于 Catch22、TSFresh、BasicStats、MiniRocket 等手工特征，验证了预训练表征对能力估计的有效性；(iii) 在合成到真实、留一数据集出、域内有限支持三种算法选择迁移设置下，TS-Router 均优于或与经典算法选择器（SATzilla、ARGOSMART、MetaOD、ISAC、MSAD、UReg）相当，且无需真实标签历史。
AI.conclusion: TS-Router 重新定位了时间序列基础模型在 TSAD 中的角色：可迁移的时间表征用于评估和路由专用检测器，而非直接充当统一的异常评分器。理论分析在显式迁移假设下给出了 Top-k 集合能力的遗憾界，实验在多个冻结 TSFM 编码器和大规模基准上验证了"通用表征 → 专用能力估计 → 自适应选择与融合"路径的有效性。该方法受模拟任务分布覆盖范围影响，且当前多变量处理采用逐变量路由，未显式建模跨变量交互。

title: Can AI Scientists Coordinate at Runtime?
comment: 35 pages (9 pages main text), 4 figures, 10 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Multi-agent AI scientists have shown improving performance across a diverse range of tasks. Yet a common approach is design-time agentic orchestration, which typically relies on fixed workflows. In contrast, human scientists coordinate and adjust their division of labor at runtime. We therefore ask: can AI scientists also coordinate at runtime? To this end, we introduce Runtime Agent Coordination (RAC), which selects agents from existing AI-scientist hosts during execution, assigns scoped work contracts, and provides artifact-grounded verification. Verification informs subsequent agents without blocking transitions or discarding artifacts. We conduct a single-seed exploratory evaluation across Agent Laboratory, EvoScientist, and ARK on ResearchClawBench, preserving host models, tools, and permissions under host-calibrated budgets. Four cumulative conditions separate native execution, runtime communication, runtime selection, and the combined addition of contracts and verification. Runtime selection yields the highest observed mean score for each host; adding contracts and verification reduces these means, with host-dependent outcomes relative to native execution. These results motivate runtime coordination while exposing the limits of additional coordination mechanisms under constrained budgets. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Runtime Agent Coordination (RAC) 框架，在运行时根据当前研究状态选择已有 AI 科学家主机中的智能体，并加入合同（contracts）和验证（verification）机制。在 Agent Laboratory、EvoScientist 和 ARK 三个主机上以单种子探索性评估发现：纯运行时选择（R2）在所有主机上取得最高均值，加入合同与验证（R3）反而降低均值，揭示预算约束下额外协调机制的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 科学家系统大多采用设计时（design-time）固定工作流编排，缺乏运行时灵活性。人类科学家会在运行时调整分工，而长周期科研失败具有状态依赖特征，固定流程无法有效应对多样化情境，因此需要探索运行时协调机制。
AI.method: 提出 RAC 框架，保留各主机的原生智能体、工具和权限，通过四种累积条件（N0 原生执行、R1 加入运行通信、R3 加入运行选择、R3 加入合同与验证）在 ResearchClawBench 上进行单种子评估，跨 Agent Laboratory、EvoScientist、ARK 三个主机比较研究得分、token 使用与推理成本，并进行 trace 级分析和 DiscoveryBench 迁移测试。
AI.result: R2 在所有主机上取得最高均值（ARK 18.42，Agent Lab 12.08，EvoScientist 18.53）；R3 均值低于 R2，呈现主机依赖性；R3 改善了 Agent Lab 和 ARK 的均值但对 EvoScientist 几乎无变化。DiscoveryBench 上 R3 取得最大增益。trace 级分析揭示三种协调效应——证据-行动闭合、诊断后规划停滞、自洽性漂移。
AI.conclusion: RAC 证明运行时协调是设计时工作流的有意义的替代方案，但额外协调机制（合同与验证）在预算受限条件下不一定带来改善。运行时选择能最高效地优化资源分配；合同与验证的细粒度检查可捕捉局部缺陷，但与全局研究目标的连接仍需加强。单种子评估限制结论稳健性。

title: The Devil Is in the Reconstruction Loss Scale: Rethinking Optimization in LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods typically use sequential quantization that partitions a pre-trained LLM into a series of units (e.g., transformer blocks), with one unit quantized at each stage. State-of-the-art PTQ methods are predominantly learning-based, optimizing auxiliary quantization parameters (e.g., scaling factors, rotation matrices, clipping thresholds, and adapters) via gradient descent to minimize a reconstruction loss. A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. Through extensive empirical studies spanning representative learning-based PTQ methods, LLM families, model scales, architectures, quantization settings and various tasks, we consistently uncover Optimization Imbalance: reconstruction loss magnitudes vary dramatically across stages, accompanied by highly uneven gradient magnitudes and parameter updates under MSE. We term the cross-stage range of loss magnitudes the reconstruction loss scale, and reveal that MSE translates the unexpectedly large reconstruction loss scale into highly uneven gradient magnitudes, which in turn lead to uneven optimization strength across quantization stages. This finding suggests a general principle for improving learning-based PTQ: optimization strength across stages should be decoupled from the reconstruction loss scale. Theoretically, we show that root mean squared error (RMSE) variants defined at the sample, channel, token, and element levels naturally realize this principle through implicit gradient normalization, outperforming MSE significantly as a drop-in replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文系统揭示了基于学习的LLM后训练量化(PTQ)中使用MSE重构损失所导致的"优化不平衡"问题，并提出使用RMSE及其四种变体作为即插即用的替代方案，通过隐式梯度归一化实现跨量化阶段的均衡优化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的PTQ方法普遍采用MSE作为逐阶段（transformer block顺序量化）重构损失，但MSE所引发的优化行为从未被系统研究。在顺序量化中，每一阶段量化误差会传播累积到后续阶段，因此优化强度在各阶段之间应当均衡。然而，MSE损失会使优化强度与重构损失幅度耦合，导致部分阶段优化不足。作者旨在揭示并解决这一被忽视的核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 对四种代表性基于学习的PTQ方法(OmniQuant、DuQuant、FlatQuant、SliderQuant)、三类LLM家族(LLaMA2/3.1、Qwen3.5)、多种模型规模(7B-35B，含dense与MoE架构)及五种量化设置(W4A16/W3A16/W2A16/W2A16G128/W4A4)进行广泛的实证分析，追踪各阶段的重构损失、输出空间梯度、参数空间梯度与参数更新幅度。2) 理论推导MSE输出空间梯度范数与重构损失均方根成正比，从而导致跨阶段梯度幅度差异超过100×。3) 提出RMSE作为MSE的平方根变换，其输出空间梯度范数恒为1/√N（与损失幅度无关），从而打破损失依赖耦合；并定义四种基于不同特征分组（sample/channel/token/element）的RMSE变体。
AI.result: 实验覆盖语言建模、常识推理、数学推理(GSM8K、MATH-500)、编码(HumanEval、MBPP)任务。在所有PTQ方法、模型家族与量化设置下，四种RMSE变体一致优于MSE，W2A16下绝对精度提升5.44%–10.83%，W4A4下提升0.75%–8.05%。改进随量化激进程度增大而增大，且RMSE不引入可训练参数或超参数，运行时与显存开销可忽略（±2.82%）。LLaMA家族偏好RMSE-Token，Qwen家族偏好RMSE-Channel。
AI.conclusion: 优化不平衡是基于学习的PTQ中由MSE损失依赖的梯度缩放引起的系统性现象，在顺序量化中尤为关键。RMSE作为即插即用的损失函数替代方案，通过隐式梯度归一化实现跨阶段均衡优化，在激进量化下带来尤为显著的性能提升。优化行为应被视为基于学习的PTQ未来研究中与量化设计并列的基本设计考量。特征分组作为梯度归一化的应用维度，提供了超越所研究四种变体的更广泛的均衡优化设计空间。

title: Distilling Directional Verification
summary: Knowledge distillation aims to transfer the factual knowledge of large language models to smaller models for efficient deployment. Yet a teacher may recall a relation in one direction while failing to generate the answer in the reverse direction. Distillation from its generated answers can therefore propagate this directional limitation to the student. The same teacher can nevertheless recognize such an answer by scoring the relation in the direction it knows. We introduce directional label distillation, in which frozen teachers score candidate answers in that known direction and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target. On facts about parents and their children, known-direction scoring yields more accurate labels than scoring the requested direction, even after tuned corrections for name priors. With prior-corrected scores, the better direction depends on the facts rather than the template, and reverses on mined facts whose notable entity is the parent rather than the child. With the evaluated children's forward facts withheld, students trained on known-direction labels improve open-ended accuracy on their trained queries by 13 to 15 points over students trained on prior-corrected reverse labels. After generated answers are matched to a fixed name list by lexical similarity, students reproduce nearly all selected labels. Their accuracy largely follows label quality. The label advantage holds on unscreened queries and when candidates are retrieved without inserting correct answers. Our findings show that directional verification mitigates the transfer of errors from teacher-generated answers to students by providing more accurate training targets. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出"方向性标签蒸馏"(directional label distillation)，通过让冻结的教师模型在"已知方向"(child→parent)上对候选答案进行评分来选择伪标签，训练学生回答反向查询(parent→child)，从而缓解"反转诅咒"(reversal curse)带来的错误传播问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在"反转诅咒"：能在一个方向回忆关系却无法在反方向生成答案。传统知识蒸馏使用教师生成的反向答案作为训练目标，会将教师在反向查询上的错误传递给学生。先前研究要么改变训练数据、要么改变训练目标，但均未解决"如何从反向查询不可靠的预训练教师那里获取准确反向标签"的问题。
AI.method: 1) 从固定姓名库中检索候选子集；2) 冻结的多个教师模型在"已知方向"(child→parent)上对每个候选孩子进行评分(评分父名在"{child}'s parent is"后的生成概率)；3) 取平均得分最高的候选(排除查询父名本身)作为伪标签；4) 使用掩码扩散学生模型(MDM)和自回归学生模型，在"反向"(parent→child)上进行监督训练；5) 比较了多种聚合规则(raw-score、z-score、probability means、Borda、RRF、soft agreement)；6) 反向比较器包括先验修正的反向评分、教师生成等。
AI.result: 1) 在筛选和未筛选的Wikidata父子事实集上，已知方向标签比反向评分(即使经过先验修正)更准确；2) 在评估孩子的正向事实被保留的情况下，已知方向标签使学生的开放式准确率比先验修正的反向标签提升13-15个百分点；3) 标签优势在未筛选查询和不插入正确答案的候选检索中均成立；4) 学生几乎能复现所有被选中的标签，准确率与标签质量高度相关；5) 更好的方向取决于事实本身(取决于著名实体是父还是子)而非模板；6) 没有任何父→子答案标签训练的学生准确率低于3%，包括使用任意顺序掩码训练的学生。
AI.conclusion: 方向性验证(利用教师在已知方向上的评分能力)能够为反向查询提供显著更准确的训练监督信号，从而有效缓解反转诅咒导致的错误传递。这一方法为解决反转诅咒提供了一条"利用验证能力将现有关系知识转化为反向监督"的更广泛路径。

title: Groundability, Not Scale Alone: When Weak Reviewers Can Audit Strong Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents can return plausible patches that omit required behavior. These failures are hard to review because long traces and confident summaries often hide what was missed. We ask when a nominally weaker reviewer can reliably decide whether a patch solves its issue. We study 411 execution-labeled traces from three agents and 101 controlled cases. On 154 GPT-5.4 traces, structured but unchecked evidence raises both defect catch and over-rejection. We then provide official execution evidence as an upper-bound diagnostic. After choosing and freezing one of two formats per reviewer, five of six reviewers improve both rates on 122 held-out traces; two classify every trace correctly. Reviewer size is not a consistent predictor of quality. Because official tests are unavailable in deployment, we also evaluate a frozen cascade with patch-caused static errors and generated tests that first fail on the unpatched repository. On 121 scored held-out GPT-5.4 traces and 59 Gemini traces, its coverage is 0.89 and 0.86, risk is 0.33 and 0.26, catch is 0.76 and 0.80, and over-rejection is 0.66 and 0.67. Most false rejections occur when unresolved cases reach the reviewer. Official execution evidence shows the potential of weak review when decisive checks are available. Producing equally reliable checks without official tests remains the main bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"较弱的评审者"能否可靠审核代码审查任务的补丁，提出"可落地性"概念，通过411个执行标签追踪和101个受控案例，发现当提供官方执行证据时弱评审者表现优异（5/6改进切分），但模型规模并非可靠质量指标；部署级联系统使用文本替代证据仍存在较高过度拒绝率，核心瓶颈是在没有官方测试时生成可靠检查。
AI.motivation: 代码代理（如GPT-5.4）可能返回看似合理但遗漏必要行为的补丁，这类遗漏难以通过检查发现。论文探究名义上较弱的模型在何种情况下能正确判断补丁是否解决了问题，旨在理解AI审查不关注代码代理的安全审核机制。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含411个执行标签追踪和101个受控案例的审查基准，对比3种代理（GPT-5.4、Gemini、Claude）和6个不同规模的评审者（8B到235B），测试3种证据条件：原始代理证据、结构化但未检查的证据、以及官方执行证据中的"上界"诊断。同时提出一个冻结的级联检查系统，使用补丁引起的静态错误和生成的测试（需先在未补丁仓库上失败）作为部署级证据替代。
AI.result: 上界诊断中，6个评审者中有5个在122个持有集追踪上同时提高了缺陷检出率和降低了过度拒绝率，GPT-OSS-120B和GPT-4.1正确分类了全部122个。参数规模不是可靠预测因素。冻结级联在GPT-5.4和Gemini测试集上覆盖率0.89和0.86，缺陷检出率0.76和0.80，但过度拒绝率仍达0.66和0.67，21个虚假拒绝中有19个发生在未检查证据上。
AI.conclusion: 官方执行证据提供了上界：弱评审者在决定性检查可用时可以可靠。异质评测模型阶梯中参数规模无法一致预测审查质量。当前生成的检查仍不足：持有集过度拒绝率为0.66，一个通过的测试不能证明正确性。实际系统应优先考虑可靠的检查（如本文级联设计）而非更大的评审者。

title: It Takes Workflows to Evolve Better Workflows
summary: Tackling complex real-world tasks can exceed the capabilities of a single large language model (LLM), motivating the use of multi-agent workflows that coordinate specialized agents to work together on these tasks. Recent methods train LLMs to construct better workflows from execution outcomes, but they optimize only the workflow generator, while the other agents that build or execute each workflow remain fixed even though every outcome depends on all of them. However, extending training beyond the generator is challenging: the agents are coupled, and a workflow's outcome is a single sparse score that cannot tell which agent causes a failure. We propose FloWright, which leverages the workflow as a harness to optimize workflows. By introducing a hierarchical, structure-aware reward paradigm, FloWright enables one role to self-evolve and two or more roles to co-evolve, with no additional models, labels, or executions. Considering the limitation that workflows are commonly trained and evaluated on data that a single agent can already handle, we further propose DataWright, an adaptive data hardening approach that converts existing datasets into workflow-level tasks with increased difficulty. Across document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, small open models trained with FloWright achieve improved performance by up to $+7.41\%$, with co-evolving ($+5.03\%$) more roles gaining more than optimizing one of them alone ($+2.83\%$). Our project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: FloWright提出了一种将工作流本身作为优化"harness"的框架，通过分层结构感知奖励实现多智能体工作流中多个角色的自演化与协同演化（包括训练时强化学习和测试时元蒸馏），配合DataWright数据硬化方法，在文档、幻灯片、图表、代码、数学和金融等任务上使小型开源模型获得最高+7.41%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体工作流优化方法仅训练工作流生成器（generator），而构建和执行工作流的其余智能体保持固定，限制了整体性能提升。此外，工作流结果是一个无法区分失败根源的单一稀疏分数；且现有评估数据集多可被单一智能体解决，无法体现工作流的协调价值。
AI.method: FloWright将工作流作为"harness"统一提供评估信号、训练信号和测试时目标：1) 分层结构感知奖励，将稀疏结果转化为角色级稠密反馈（格式f、有效性v^ρ、执行e、答案a、结构感知信用c_j^ρ）；2) 从执行轨迹中无需额外模型/标注/执行即可完成角色级信用定位；3) 支持四种演化模式——单角色自演化、智能体-技能协同演化、上游-下游协同演化、多智能体协同演化（互为课程）；4) 测试时通过元蒸馏生成可复用先验；5) DataWright通过Shared/Paired/Decoy三种硬化策略将单智能体可处理的数据集转化为工作流级任务。
AI.result: 在12个数据集、7个领域、共44个评估臂（4个分布内+13个分布外+27个域外）上，Qwen3.5-4B/9B经FloWright训练后相对未训练工作流基线提升最高+7.41%；多智能体协同演化增益+5.03%，优于单角色自演化的+2.83%；元蒸馏额外带来+2.58%增益；训练时与测试时优化可叠加至+3.21%。增益在RL算法（GRPO/DAPO/CISPO）、工作流拓扑、池粒度与池动态等消融中均成立，并可迁移至未训练的backbone。
AI.conclusion: FloWright证明了以工作流为harness进行多角色协同演化的可行性：单一共享信号可同时作为评估指标、训练目标和测试时蒸馏目标，分层结构感知奖励在零额外成本下提供角色级信用分配；协同演化更多角色优于仅优化单一角色；DataWright硬化后的工作流级任务才能真正衡量和提升工作流相对单智能体的价值。

title: Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise
summary: Machine learning models often suffer performance degradation under subpopulation shift, particularly when spurious correlations cause models to rely on shortcut features that fail to generalize across subgroups. A recent line of work mitigates this issue by using loss-based signals to identify informative samples, but these signals can become severely distorted under label noise: mislabeled samples may also incur large losses and contaminate subsequent reweighting or retraining. Despite its practical importance, this intersection remains largely underexplored. We propose POTER, a reweighting framework based on optimal transport that derives sample importance from the transport geometry between the training distribution and a reference distribution constructed from limited validation group annotations. By measuring alignment at the individual-sample level rather than relying on loss, POTER downweights mislabeled or strongly bias-aligned samples while assigning higher importance to samples better aligned with the reference distribution. In addition, POTER requires only a single ERM training stage, moving beyond the retraining paradigm common in recent work. Across standard benchmarks and noisy-label settings, POTER achieves state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy, including cases where label corruption is concentrated within minority subgroups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出POTER，一种基于最优传输（OT）的样本重加权框架，用于在虚假相关性和标签噪声双重挑战下实现鲁棒学习。核心创新在于利用OT对偶势能从训练分布与参考分布之间的传输几何中推导样本重要性，无需基于损失的样本选择或重训练阶段，仅需单次ERM训练即可在标准基准和噪声标签设置下取得最优最差组精度。
AI.motivation: 现有虚假相关性缓解方法依赖基于损失的代理信号来识别有信息量的样本，但在标签噪声下该假设脆弱——被错误标注的样本同样会产生大损失，从而污染后续的重加权或重训练流程。此外，现有方法多需重训练，计算开销大；在标签噪声集中于少数子群的"子群集中标签噪声"设置下，性能进一步恶化。
AI.method: 1. **参考分布构建**：利用有限验证集的组注释，构建按组加权混合的经验参考分布，对偏差冲突的少数组赋予更高权重。2. **类条件最优传输**：求解训练分布与参考分布之间的OT问题（仅在同类别样本间传输，代价为预训练特征空间的欧氏距离），获得对偶势能 f*。3. **样本重加权**：通过KL正则化优化将 f* 转化为指数形式权重 w_i* ∝ exp(-f_i*/τ)，对与参考分布对齐良好的样本赋予更高重要性。
AI.result: 在CMNIST、Waterbirds、CelebA、CivilComments四个标准基准上，POTER在使用验证组标签的方法中达到最优最差组精度（CMNIST 72.5%、Waterbirds 90.9%、CelebA 90.4%）。对称标签噪声下，30%噪声时在Waterbirds上达到85.3%（KNN-RAD为68.9%）。子群集中标签噪声下显著优于KNN-RAD（如Waterbirds 60%噪声时78.3% vs 7.5%）。OT计算开销极低（最大数据集仅4.52秒），无需任何重训练阶段。
AI.conclusion: POTER是首个基于OT的虚假相关性缓解重加权框架，通过基于参考分布对齐的样本重要性机制，以单一统一的加权规则同时处理虚假相关性和标签噪声，无需代理样本选择或重训练管道。其类条件对偶势能有效识别偏差冲突样本并抑制错标样本，揭示了先前被忽视的子群集中标签噪声失败模式，为子群体偏移下的鲁棒学习提供了新方向。局限性在于仍依赖具有代表性且类别标注的验证集。

title: Capturing In-Context Learning Dynamics with Task Operators
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to perform new tasks from demonstrations without weight updates. However, every ICL inference requires processing the full set of examples, resulting in inefficient deployments, and how ICL works mechanistically is not fully understood. Prior work compresses ICL into fixed activation vectors extracted from specific layers or positions, but these input-independent interventions fail on complex tasks where the output depends on fine-grained interactions with the input. By analyzing the ICL forward pass, we show that each attention head's output is an affine transformation of its context-masked counterpart, and that the parameters of this transformation are empirically stable across samples for a given task. Building on this, we introduce Task Operator (TO), which replays this transformation as an analytically derived update to the attention output projection. Across lexical, algorithmic, and reasoning tasks, TO achieves the best overall performance among prior methods and substantially narrows the gap between zero-shot inference and ICL. We further show that the extracted knowledge concentrates in a task-specific sparse circuit across layers and positions, and that averaging operators from disjoint demonstration batches enables effective many-shot scaling without expanding the context window. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Task Operator (TO)，一种无需训练的方法，通过分析ICL前向传播中注意力头的仿射变换结构，将上下文学习知识提炼为注意力输出投影的参数更新，在零样本推理时动态重放，有效压缩ICL并显著缩小零样本与少样本性能差距。
AI.motivation: ICL虽强大但需重复处理全部示例导致推理效率低下；现有压缩方法（如Task Vectors、Function Vectors）仅提取固定加性激活向量，无法捕捉复杂任务中输出对输入的细粒度依赖关系，且ICL的内在机制尚不完全清楚。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三步：(1) 理论推导证明每个注意力头的ICL输出是其context-masked版本的仿射变换（缩放因子w + 偏置b），参数跨样本稳定；(2) 将该变换重参数化为输出投影W̃_O = W_O·D和偏置b̃_O的更新，在零样本推理时注入；(3) 通过per-site干预的NLL因果分析识别稀疏任务电路，并支持对不重叠演示批次取平均以实现many-shot扩展。
AI.result: 在4个LLM（Qwen3-4B/8B、Llama3.2-3B、Llama3.1-8B）和8个任务（词法、算法、推理）上，TO在几乎所有模型-任务组合上 consistently 优于TV、FV、ICV、Conceptor基线，大幅缩小零样本与8-shot ICL的差距；消融实验证实乘法缩放与加性偏置均不可或缺，且不同任务依赖不同位置类型（模板/内容/输出）的稀疏电路；批量平均策略支持不扩窗口的many-shot扩展。
AI.conclusion: TO建立了ICL与参数微调之间的直接机制联系，既是实用的高效部署工具（避免重复处理示例），也是理解Transformer如何通过演示重塑计算的可解释性透镜。

title: Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives
summary: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

AI.tldr: Madeleine提出"摊销关联"范式：通过LLM生活模拟器离线生成(trigger, cue)训练对，在冻结相似度之上学习查询端的残差关联LoRA适配器，实现零LLM调用的联想式对话记忆检索，在LoCoMo-Plus上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有对话记忆系统依赖LLM在写入或读取时进行推理以建立联想关联，代价高昂（每记忆库数百至上千次LLM调用、每次查询数千上下文token）。心理学中的"不随意记忆"（involuntary memory）表明关联应是无需努力的System 1过程，作者将其重新表述为可学习的相关性——生活轨迹下的逐点互信息（PMI）。
AI.method: 1) 生活模拟器：使用GPT-4.1-mini和DeepSeek生成三类模拟生活（v2静态事实、v3轨迹、v2d），每条陈述配三条不泄露原话题的后续话语和一条直接问题，经过去污染处理；2) 残差关联检索器：在冻结的Qwen3-Embedding-4B基础上，仅在查询端添加LoRA（rank 32），得分=冻结相似度+学习的关联余弦；3) 训练目标：InfoNCE损失，采用同源负样本，温度0.05，批量128，仅1个epoch。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo-Plus官方协议下：(I) 嵌入HyperMem后达到66.6分，为所有评估系统中最高；(II) 独立使用时以52.4分追平HyperMem原始分数（52.9），且零LLM调用、上下文仅为1/21（375 vs 7817 token）；(III) 提升T-Mem 26.2分；在4B骨干上不影响普通QA性能（58.9-60.0 vs 59.1）。
AI.conclusion: 联想记忆是可学习的相关性而非需LLM实时推理；通过摊销关联将System 2推理离线化、蒸馏为System 1的快速检索，既保持与最先进LLM构建记忆系统相当的性能，又大幅降低成本并具有即插即用性。

title: Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?
summary: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"策略空间缩放"(policy-space scaling)新范式，通过SURGE方法从已完成的RL训练历史中构建出比最优检查点更强的单一部署策略，无需额外训练或增加推理计算。
AI.motivation: 传统的推理能力提升依赖延长RL训练或增加推理时计算。作者质疑这一假设：已完成的RL训练历史是否已包含足够结构来构建更强的策略，从而开辟一条新的"策略空间缩放"维度。
AI.method: SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion) 是一种无梯度的权重融合方法：(1) 从同一RL运行中选取高精度anchor和响应更短的donor两个检查点；(2) 将两者表示为相对于共享初始化的delta更新；(3) 对anchor的delta做SVD谱分解，保留其保护块（前k个主导奇异方向）；(4) 用donor的互补分量替换anchor保护块外的部分。融合控制(FC)参数通过权重中保留的能量比例（τ=0.95）自动校准，无需精度扫描。该构造是参数空间中的非仿射操作，生成的策略与任何标量插值都不同。
AI.result: 在三个RL训练历史上验证：(1) DeepSeek-1.5B数学推理：AIME24达54.17%，超越19个原生检查点中最优的50.83%，平均精度提升2.08点，token减少5.3%；(2) Nemotron-1.5B：平均精度提升1.78点，token减少12.8%；(3) OLMo-7B代码：HumanEval+达83.7%，超越最优原生82.8%，token减少10.3%。消融实验证明delta-first SVD（54.17% vs 41.67%绝对权重SVD）、保护块几何、donor互补贡献均不可或缺，标量插值、checkpoint平均、随机子空间等基线均无法复现增益。
AI.conclusion: RL训练历史是可复用的缩放资源。优化器访问的检查点不必代表该训练历史的能力上限。策略空间缩放将已有的RL更新重新组合为单一可部署策略，与训练时缩放和推理时缩放互补，为RL扩展策略提供了新维度。

title: Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift
summary: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DR-TFM，一种参数高效的分布鲁棒适配框架，通过仅微调查询缩放网络（仅更新TabPFN-3的0.016%参数）来缓解子群体偏移下表格基础模型的性能退化，无需真实组标签即可在多个表格基准上显著提升最差组准确率。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）虽然在平均准确率上表现强劲，但在子群体偏移（训练和部署数据中各子群体比例发生变化）下，对代表性不足群体的性能可能严重下降。现有TFM适配方法未明确针对子群体偏移，且传统鲁棒学习方法需要真实组标签或修改大量模型参数。
AI.method: DR-TFM框架将分布鲁棒优化（DRO）与TFM适配相结合，通过两种方式构建模糊集：(1) DR-TFM (GR) 基于聚类预训练TFM嵌入估计的伪组使用GroupDRO；(2) DR-TFM (MS) 使用多源DRO，通过聚类或重采样构建源子集。两种方法都仅通过微调一个轻量级的查询缩放网络（query scaling network）来调整查询向量各坐标的缩放因子，从而重新加权查询对上下文样本的注意力，保持所有其他预训练参数固定。
AI.result: 在5个表格基准测试和ACS Income数据集上，DR-TFM (GR)和DR-TFM (MS)的平均最差组准确率分别比TabPFN提升24.63和21.37个百分点，且保持竞争力的平均组准确率。查询缩放策略仅更新0.016%参数，比TabPFN全模型微调快7-9倍。该方法在TabPFN-3.5、EXAONE、TabFM和Causilo四个其他TFM上也取得一致的最差组准确率提升。仿真分析显示适配后少数群体样本将更多注意力分配给自身组的上下文样本。
AI.conclusion: DR-TFM是首个明确针对子群体偏移且无需真实组标签的TFM适配框架，通过查询缩放实现参数高效、内存高效且可扩展的鲁棒适配。该方法在多个TFM上一致提升最差组性能，为表格基础模型在分布偏移下的可靠部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: When Is Deletion Ordering Tractable? From Update Dynamics to Permutation Structure
summary: Given a fixed set of pending deletion requests, retraining from scratch after each request is prohibitive, so a prescribed request-wise policy processes them sequentially. The resulting terminal model can depend on their order. Rather than prescribing an ordering rule, we study the permutation objective induced by the fixed policy and ask when it admits simpler structure. We identify two independent reductions: position additivity represents the objective by request--position costs, reducing optimization to assignment and, with a shared positional profile, sorting; suffix localization removes dependence on the distant prefix while retaining interactions among the surviving requests. Under shared affine updates, we characterize the quadratic interactions that obstruct additivity, prove the reductions' independence, and show that suffix-conditioned assignment improves the approximation rate from O(p^L) toO(p^(2L)). Experiments recover both structures in executed objectives. A controlled damped-Newton sweep shows that stronger contraction shifts the objective toward shorter, more suffix-specific dependence, while two full-network policies exhibit distinct positional and within-suffix structure. Structures identified from compact execution sets also predict unseen orders. These results frame deletion ordering as identifying the computational structure induced by the executed updates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器遗忘中删除请求的执行顺序问题，将其建模为固定请求集上的排列目标函数，并提出两种独立的结构简化：位置可加性（可化归为指派或排序问题）和后缀定位（仅依赖最近请求），刻画了不同更新动态下何种简化成立的条件及其组合效果。
AI.motivation: 在近似遗忘中，请求的删除顺序会影响最终模型，但现有工作仅提供排序规则（如基于不确定性、难度），未刻画由此顺序所诱导的排列优化问题的计算结构。本文旨在回答：何时该排列目标函数具有更简单的结构，从而实现高效优化。
AI.method: （1）将删除排序建模为排列目标函数 $J(\pi)$，识别两种独立简化——位置可加性（$\rightarrow$ 指派/排序）与后缀定位；（2）在共享仿射更新下，刻画平方终端距离引入的二次项交互，量化偏离可加性的残差，给出排序/指派的近似边界（Proposition 1）；（3）证明收缩性带来 $O(\rho^L)$ 的后缀定位界，通过后缀条件化指派将其改进为 $O(\rho^{2L})$（Proposition 2）；（4）证明两种简化互相独立，且共享严格收缩下仍存在 NP 完全实例（Partition 归约，Proposition 4）；（5）实验在冻结头与全网络（NegGrad+、SalUn）场景中验证结构存在性，通过阻尼牛顿扫描因果检验收缩性的效果。
AI.result: 理论：两种简化独立可组合；共享仿射下排序/指派有近似保证；严格收缩可实现队列长度无关的后缀定位，但精确优化仍可能 NP 难。实验：冻结头目标支持位置可加性（指派主导），全网络 NegGrad+/SalUn 支持后缀定位；阻尼牛顿扫描中收缩增强使目标向后缀短时依赖转变（斜率约 1.97 vs 预测 2）；从紧凑执行集识别出的结构可迁移到未见过的排列。
AI.conclusion: 删除排序的计算结构由更新动态与终端目标共同决定：位置可加性消除跨请求-位置交互，后缀定位消除远端历史，二者通过收缩实现互补；二者均可在执行目标中观测到，且结构可从有限执行集迁移到未见顺序。建议将删除排序视为结构识别问题，再据此选择合适的求解器。

title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. Second, looped MoE suffers from expert selection collapse: routers repeatedly select the same experts across loops, so extra iterations add computation without adding computational diversity. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose LOOM, built on a single principle: each loop should contribute new computation while keeping the recurrent state stable. LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 LOOM，一种可扩展的循环 MoE 架构方案，通过残差缩放与嵌入重注入稳定循环状态，通过逐循环路由器与循环残差实现专家计算多样化，使 MoE LLMs 能稳定扩展到 9–12 个循环，在 FLOPs 匹配条件下实现有效深度扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有循环 Transformer 在 MoE 大模型、FLOPs 匹配条件下难以扩展到两个循环以上。原因是：(1) 循环放大了"深度诅咒"——残差累积导致隐状态方差爆炸、表示漂移；(2) 共享路由器导致"专家选择坍缩"——各循环反复选中相同专家，新增计算缺乏多样性。该论文旨在系统分析并解决这两大障碍。
AI.method: 核心设计原则：每个循环都应贡献新计算同时保持循环状态稳定。具体技术包括：(1) 稳定循环状态：残差缩放 γ=λ/(H√M) 限制累积，输入嵌入每轮以 g_t=λ/(t√M) 重注入以防漂移；(2) 多样化循环计算：每个循环配备独立路由器（共享专家权重），引入基于固定衰减 EMA 的 Looping Residual（含全局记忆与局部记忆）将先前输出向前传递；(3) 采用分段反向传播（K=3），限制梯度深度以降低显存与提升稳定性。
AI.result: 在 100M–1.7B 参数规模、5B–60B token 上的实验：(1) 近等 FLOP 条件下，700M 模型 5 循环最优（困惑度 18.36→16.54，零样本平均准确率 38.84%→39.53%）；(2) 非 FLOP 匹配条件下，1.7B/60B tokens 模型在 9 循环时达最佳（困惑度 9.62→7.77，平均准确率 42.4%→47.7%）；(3) 各规模模型可稳定扩展至 9–12 循环，优于仅使用残差缩放或仅嵌入重注入的基线。消融实验验证了四个组件（残差缩放、嵌入重注入、MoE RMSNorm、Looping Residual、逐循环路由）均为必要。
AI.conclusion: LOOM 成功将 MoE LLM 的循环深度扩展至远超两个循环，证明循环深度是 MoE 语言模型一条计算高效的新扩展轴线。其稳定化（残差缩放+嵌入重注入）与多样化（逐循环路由+Looping Residual）的双重设计可推广到不同参数规模，且无需重新调优循环相关超参数（λ、β、K）。

title: Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models
summary: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DLIG（Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients），一种将 Integrated Gradients 扩展到任意网络层与去噪步的 token 级归因方法，用于揭示扩散语言模型（DLM）在去噪轨迹上的渐进承诺机制。该方法在 (layer, step) 网格上提供 axiom-preserving 的评分，并被定位为介入式因果分析之前的廉价先验筛选工具。论文通过词义消歧、多跳推理和句子填充三项任务，在 DiffuGPT-M 上验证了 DLIG 的实用性。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过迭代去噪而非自回归方式生成文本，其输出的支持证据分布在网络深度与去噪时间两个维度上。然而现有 post-hoc token attribution 工具均不感知 denoising step，而 DLM 可解释性又主要依赖昂贵的介入分析（如 causal tracing）。因此需要一种轻量级、axiom-preserving 的方法，能在 (层, 步) 网格上揭示输出驱动支持在去噪轨迹中的演化。
AI.method:
1. **Scoring Function**：以模型对自身已承诺完成序列的目标对数概率之和作为评分 Ft，读出在层 ℓ 与去噪步 t 处的承诺强度。
2. **DLIG 公式**：在层 ℓ 激活空间中沿"无 prompt 基线 a' → 有 prompt 激活 a"的直线积分 ∫∂Ft/∂a 路径梯度，再与位移 (a−a') 做 elementwise 乘积，等价于将该路径的积分梯度作为 a 的归因。
3. **Per-Token 聚合**：对隐藏维求和得到每 token 归因分数 st(ℓ)[i]；完全性（completeness）保证其求和精确等于 Ft 的因果差分。
4. **IG-DLIG 等价**：定义 Gt(ℓ) 为将层 ℓ 输出覆写后重算上层并读取 Ft 的函数，证明 DLIG = IG(Gt(ℓ); a, a')，从而继承 IG 的四大公理（completeness、implementation invariance、linearity、symmetry preservation）。
5. **实现检查**：验证 hook 透明性、完备性误差收敛、双向注意门、shift 对齐门以及 partial-forward 与 full-path 的 bit-exact 一致性。
AI.result:
1. **WiC 词义消歧**：Yes/No 响应在 attribution depth 上几乎重合（AUC=0.503, p=0.916），但 commitment timing 上明显分离（AUC=0.342, p<10⁻⁴）；DLIG 廉价地排除了"决策深度差异"假说。
2. **ProsQA 多跳推理**：归因正质量显著集中在 gold 推理路径上（Wilcoxon p<10⁻¹⁵），远超随机边零分布；attribution 集中在中上层与早期去噪步，并沿推理链近乎单调上升至答案边；失败案例同样保持归因定位精度（AUC=0.524, n.s.），表明错误源于如何使用事实而非在哪里看。
3. **ROCStories 句子填充**：上下文依赖与填充质量的 Pearson r 在早期去噪步接近零，随去噪进行而增强；归因场双向、左偏（左侧 34.18 vs. 右侧 32.47，p=1.9×10⁻²⁰⁴），左/右幅度比与质量无关；DLM 能利用右侧上下文（AR 模型无法做到）。
AI.conclusion: DLIG 为 DLM 提供了一种轻量级、axiom-preserving 的 token 级归因方法，可解析到任意 (layer, step) 坐标，揭示输出支持在网络深度与去噪轨迹上的动态演化。该方法不与介入式因果分析竞争，而是作为机制假说的廉价前置筛选工具——能在更昂贵的 activation patching 或 causal tracing 之前识别或排除候选机制。论文总结："explaining a DLM means reading the whole denoising trajectory, not just its end"。

title: Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates
summary: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data. These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.

AI.tldr: 本文针对反事实生成任务，提出基于流匹配（flow matching）的端到端框架，结合样本分割的双重鲁棒训练目标和学得的源-目标耦合（通过熵最优传输），并采用基于高斯平滑插值的得分修正随机SDE采样器。核心理论贡献是给出耦合敏感（coupling-sensitive）的KL散度上界——其有限步Euler离散误差由源-目标耦合的位移矩 $D_5=(\mathbb{E}\|Y_1-Y_0\|^5)^{1/5}$ 控制，而非由速度场的全局一致正则性控制，且具有关于环境维度的近线性依赖。作者还建立了速度场与得分场的有限样本非参数保证，将逼近误差、耦合替换误差、混杂估计误差、泛化误差与蒙特卡洛误差分离，最终得到关于原始反事实目标的端到端 $W_1$ 保证。
AI.motivation: 在观察数据中进行反事实推断需要生成反事实干预下的完整结果分布，但处理分配机制的选择偏差使得直接生成困难。现有方法主要解决双重鲁棒训练问题，但忽略了源-目标耦合质量与有限步离散误差之间的联系，且其分析依赖全局正则性假设，无法直接控制由耦合位移决定的误差。
AI.method: 1. 高斯平滑插值 $X_t = Y_0 + t(Y_1-Y_0) + \sigma G$；2. 样本分割——辅助集估计倾向性、预测oracle和熵最优传输耦合 $\widehat{Q}_n$，训练集用双重鲁棒目标学习速度和得分场；3. 得分修正SDE采样器 $dZ_t = (v_t(Z_t) + \tau^2 s_t(Z_t)/2)dt + \tau dB_t$；4. Girsanov论证获得KL上界，利用后验导数恒等式将速度/得分导数表示为 $D=Y_1-Y_0$ 与高斯 $G$ 的条件矩，再通过条件方差收缩与高斯矩控制得维度近线性依赖。
AI.result: 1. 耦合敏感KL采样界：当 $\varepsilon_{vel}=\varepsilon_{score}=0$，取 $\tau^2=\sigma D_5/d$，KL误差 $\lesssim hdD_5^2/\sigma^2 + h^2 d^2 D_5^3/\sigma^3$，对应Euler步数 $\widetilde{O}(d[D_5^2/(\varepsilon_{target}^2\sigma^2) + D_5/\sigma])$，相比已有 $O(d^2)$ 改善为近线性 $O(d)$；2. 双重鲁棒速度/得分场有限样本界 $O(\mathcal{A} + (1+2\pi_{\min}^{-1})\sigma^{-(d+1)} n^{-2/(d+5)})$；3. 端到端样本复杂度 $n \gtrsim \max\{[\max\{(2+\varepsilon_{OT}^{-1})\overline{D_5}^{-1}\varepsilon_{target}^{-7}, \overline{D_5}\varepsilon_{OT}^{-1}\varepsilon_{target}^{-9}\}]^{d+2}, [(1+2\pi_{\min}^{-1})\max\{\overline{D_5}^{-1}\varepsilon_{target}^{-(d+6)}, \overline{D_5}\varepsilon_{target}^{-(2d+9)}\}]^{(d+5)/2}\}$，得到 $W_1(\mu_1, \mathcal{L}(\widehat{Z}_N)) \lesssim \varepsilon_{target}$；4. 在合成和半合成图像基准上验证耦合依赖性，并显示在有限步预算下随机SDE优于确定性ODE。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了反事实流匹配的完整框架，将耦合学习、场估计与有限步离散误差联合分析。核心创新在于：证明有限步采样误差由耦合位移矩 $D_5$ 控制而非全局正则性，并改善维度依赖至近线性。双重鲁棒学习界清晰分离多种误差来源，端到端保证为反事实生成提供了首个将耦合质量显式纳入的理论保证。实验表明，得分修正随机采样在固定步数下能改善ODE基线。

title: Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series
summary: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种LLM驱动的自动研究循环，将大语言模型用作时间序列异常检测器的"作者"而非检测器本身。循环通过反复编辑一个简短的NumPy程序，在无泄漏目标函数下保留最优检测器。最终发现了两个紧凑的检测器(单变量和多变量)，在TSB-AD基准上领先所有基线方法(包括Time-RCD基础模型)，且无需GPU训练神经网络，运行速度优于所有同等性能的基线。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测在准确性、计算效率和可解释性之间存在权衡。传统检测器便宜但需手工调参，深度模型减少调参但成本高且不透明。作者希望探索LLM驱动的程序搜索能否作为实际工具，自动发现准确、高效、透明的时间序列异常检测器。
AI.method: 1. **自主研究循环(Autoresearch Loop)**：LLM智能体迭代编辑单个Python/NumPy程序，每轮包括：(i)检查当前程序和得分，(ii)提出修改，(iii)运行验证评估，(iv)读取得分。完整轨迹(包括降低得分的尝试)保留在上下文中。2. **搜索空间约束**：候选检测器限定为短NumPy程序，固定签名(接收训练段和测试段，返回每时间步异常分数)。3. **无泄漏合成验证**：仅在每个序列训练区域的保留切片中注入合成异常(GutenTAG类型)，不接触真实标签。4. **驱动模型对比**：Opus 4.8、GPT 5.6 Terra、较小的开源MiniMax-2.5，以及ShinkaEvolve进化搜索框架。5. **发现的单变量检测器**：滑动窗口→Hann锥化→FFT功率谱→19维谱组织签名(熵、峰值集中度、质心、对数能量、对数平坦度、低/高频比、对数-对数谱斜率、复杂度坍缩项+11个对数间隔频段功率)→通过收缩全协方差马氏距离(λ=0.95)与正常训练窗口的高斯分布比较→多尺度(dyadic)融合+尾部强调权重。6. **发现的多变量检测器**：窗口长度L=80，6个频段/通道，去DC+汉宁窗后拼接所有通道为n_b×C维描述符，用池化岭正则化协方差(η=10⁻²)拟合高斯模型，用平方马氏距离评分；窗口跨步采样并硬限上限(4000)以保证近线性运行。
AI.result: 1. **TSB-AD基准**：Opus 4.8环路在四个指标(隶属F、F1-T、标准F1、VUS-PR)的16个数据族中获得第一名最多。VUS-PR上获得8个第一，标准F1上获得9个第一。多变量侧TSB-AD上GPT 5.6 Terra环路略胜Opus，但TAB上Opus领先。2. **效率**：多变量检测器是所有方法中最快的(0.054秒/序列)；单变量约5μs/步，与LOF相当。比GPU深度检测器快40-120倍。Time-RCD仅因GPU批量前向略快。3. **消融研究**：驱动模型最重要(Opus大幅领先)，搜索程序影响较小。但agentic循环产生单原理、紧凑、可读的程序；ShinkaEvolve进化搜索即使在相同提示下也收敛到标准方法的臃肿集成。4. **新颖性验证**：用catch22特征替代发现的谱签名后VUS-PR从53.9降至28.4，说明优势来自特定描述符组合而非新颖性框架本身。5. **TAB基准验证**：多变量侧Opus在所有四个范围感知指标上第一；单变量侧Opus在ROC指标上领先，KMeans在精度指标上领先；区域隶属F上Opus仅为中游(因其产生尖锐峰值而非宽区域)。6. **发现成本**：每个检测器在约1小时会话、约100次编辑评估迭代中产生，可通过20美元订阅计划访问。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的程序搜索是发现准确、高效、透明时间序列异常检测器的实用路径。Opus 4.8环路发现了两个基于谱-高斯新思想的紧凑单原理检测器，在TSB-AD基准上领先所有经典、深度和基础模型基线(包括Time-RCD)，同时无需GPU训练、无神经网络、单CPU运行、代码可审计。这一方法将人类工作从设计检测器转移到设计评估harness、合成异常生成器和优化目标，同时保持成本可承受。限制包括：对合成异常先验的依赖、TSB-AD上的优势不完全推广到TAB所有指标、需更广泛基准验证。

title: Judgement in the Age of Jev: From Evaluation Scarcity to Evaluation Abundance
summary: Generative artificial intelligence has reduced the cost of producing plausible symbolic artefacts, leading recent organisation scholarship to identify evaluation and discernment as constraints under conditions of production abundance. This perspective examines a further possibility: that machine evaluation itself becomes inexpensive enough to be deployed routinely and at scale. The investigation is prompted by Jev, TypeSafe AI's specialised model for typed probabilistic decisions. TypeSafe explicitly invokes William Stanley Jevons to argue that lower-cost machine intelligence can unlock previously uneconomic uses. Treating this as a technological provocation rather than an established empirical result, the article formulates a conditional Jevons hypothesis for machine evaluation: sufficiently large reductions in the total marginal cost of usable machine evaluation may increase its organisational consumption where latent demand is substantial and complementary costs do not dominate. The article integrates rebound economics with research on cheap prediction, production abundance, machine evaluation, decision allocation, authority, reliance and Executive Judgement to examine this possible scarcity transition. It distinguishes prediction, machine evaluation, organisational judgement and authorisation as functional activities whose costs need not fall together. Evaluations can share evidence, criteria and errors; scale mis-specified rubrics; operate on representations from which consequential qualifications have disappeared; and change practical decision rights through thresholds and exception routing. The resulting research problem is when cheap machine evaluation substitutes for human evaluative work, when it redistributes or creates demands for judgement, and how it affects the grounds available at consequential organisational commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文以TypeSafe AI推出的"系统一模型"Jev为技术触发点，提出一个条件性"杰文斯假设"——当机器评估的边际成本充分下降时，组织对评估的消费总量可能增加而非减少。文章系统区分预测、机器评估、组织判断与授权四类功能活动，整合廉价预测、生产过剩、算法依赖与Executive Judgement等文献，论证评估数量的增加并不等同于组织判断的丰裕，并提出六项研究方向。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已使符号化产出的生产成本急剧下降，导致组织中出现"辨识鸿沟"（Cao等，2026）：生产过剩而评估稀缺。作者追问一个对称性问题——若评估本身也变得廉价，组织会发生什么？Jev作为首个明确以Jevons悖论逻辑命名的"软件原生决策原语"模型，为该问题提供了具体的技术切入点。
AI.method: 概念性综合分析（integrative conceptual synthesis）。采用"破坏性比较"策略：从Jev这一具体技术观察出发，检视既有廉价预测、自动化、人机决策、认知分布、依赖性与权威等理论是否已充分解释所提出的组织后果；进而区分预测、机器评估、组织判断与授权四种功能活动，并提出条件性杰文斯假设；同时将Executive Judgement（Hill, 2026）作为理论透镜而非独立过程理论加以运用。
AI.result: 1.形式化提出"机器评估的杰文斯假设"：若评估边际成本与延迟充分下降、潜在需求显著且互补成本不占主导，组织将增加评估消费总量、频率、粒度与范围。2.明确该假设的失败条件（潜在需求不足、互补成本主导、合规约束等）。3.论证评估丰裕不等于判断丰裕：评估可共享证据、标准与错误（Kohli 2026显示9个LLM评判器仅相当于约2个独立投票）；可放大错误的标准；可在表征已丢失关键限定信息后运作；可通过阈值与异常路由改变实际决策权。4.识别五类可能迁移的约束：基础证据、标准选择、独立性、解释性注意力、权威与干预。5.提出六项实证研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献在于精确的功能区分与一个有条件的研究议程，而非提出全新的因果机制。中心结论是：评估量不是组织授权正当性的代理指标——一百次评估若共享同一证据与错误结构，可能仅增加极少的独立信息；一个完美一致的评估器可放大错误标准；下游的精确检验无法恢复已从表征中消失的关键限定。Jev使"评估廉价化"这一稀缺性转变变得具体可研究，但杰文斯反弹仍是待检验的假设，Jev的厂商报告性能亦非独立证据。真正的问题不在于机器能否"判断"，而在于当评估廉价到几乎可随处使用时，组织承诺的正当性基础会发生何种变化。

title: Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems
summary: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers from 8,000 institutions, producing around 400,000 publication decisions and 1.2 million LLM-generated peer reviews. Using these longitudinal simulations, we find that rejection-driven resubmission substantially amplifies reviewer burden beyond population growth alone, cautious exploration balances citation impact with career success and long-term topic diversity, and resource inequality can emerge even without detectable cumulative advantage from narrowly winning early funding. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SciUtopia (Suto)是一个基于LLM智能体的闭环模拟框架，用于纵向研究学术研究生态系统。它建模了科研方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、再投、引文、资助和研究人员流失等相互关联的过程。框架基于真实文献语料库（SciEvo），在61个模拟世界中运行超过40,000名研究人员、约400,000次投稿决策和120万次同行评审，用于研究制度机制如何随时间影响科研生态。
AI.motivation: 随着AI日益深度参与科研全周期，理解研究者、机构、资助机构、合作网络和科学文献共同演化的生态系统变得迫切。然而在真实学术界中，控制性制度干预往往不可行，反事实结果不可观测。LLM智能体为在受控环境中研究日益AI中介化的科研过程提供了自然载体。该工作旨在提供一个闭环、纵向视角，理解AI对个体科研活动的改变如何在演化的科学环境中传播，产生生态系统层面的收益与意外后果。
AI.method: Suto将科研建模为一个由六阶段组成的年度闭环循环：研究方向选择与合作→投稿与引文→同行评审→论文决策与记忆更新→资助分配与人员流失→再投。每个研究人员维护包含专业领域、声誉、预算、记忆和利益冲突的状态。科学产物基于SciEvo语料库的arXiv论文检索，确保科学可信度。框架通过匹配的反事实实验设计，分离制度机制的影响与反馈效应。主要模型为Qwen3-32B，研究方向集合包含53个，模拟时间对应2016–2025年。
AI.result: 核心发现包括：(1) 拒绝驱动的再投大幅放大了审稿人负担——仅人口增长使人均审稿数从2.07升至2.25，但再投使其升至6.64；更严格的接收标准使审稿工作量再增加14%。(2) 发表量增长可能掩盖科研参与的下降——投稿上限翻倍使接收量增加63–69%，但十年活跃率从39%降至24%。(3) 谨慎探索者（cautious explorers）在引文影响力上优于纯探索者和纯利用者，且仅在接受率和资助上略有下降；当多数研究者采用此策略时，长期主题多样性更高。(4) 窄幅早期资助获胜在三年内未显示显著职业优势，但资源不平等从基尼≈0.04升至≈0.36，同时主题多样性保持高位。(5) 透露作者姓名和机构使LLM评审分数小幅提升0.055–0.077分（1–5量表）。
AI.conclusion: Suto作为一个整体性、基于LLM的框架，将研究方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、再投、引文、资助、记忆和流失整合到单一文献接地的闭环中。该框架为政策制定者提供了受控的测试平台，用于理解局部决策如何积累为长期科学动力学，回答的不仅是个体行为问题，还包括学术制度规则如何塑造哪些研究能够生存、传播并最终获得成功的问题。该工作为理解AI中介日益增强时代的科研生态系统奠定了基础。

title: Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research
comment: Tutorial with eight controlled scenarios; includes MATLAB and Python/scikit-learn code listings
summary: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于EEG、OCT、临床和多中心数据模型验证方法的教程性论文，系统综述了各类验证策略（留出法、k折交叉验证、分层、留一/留p、分组感知、嵌套交叉验证等），并通过八个受控场景对比了有缺陷设计与防泄漏设计，强调"独立单元须匹配部署目标，且所有数据相关操作必须排除用于性能估计的样本"。
AI.motivation: 模型验证常因划分不当产生乐观且稳定的错误结果，导致泛化性能被高估，尤其在医学与神经科学数据（具有层级结构、重复测量、多中心来源）场景下尤为严重。本文旨在系统梳理常见验证方法、剖析常见泄漏来源，并为实践者提供可复现的对照实验与决策指导。
AI.method: 1. 文献综述与原则提炼：归纳独立单元、观测单元、部署目标、数据依赖操作（特征选择、归一化等）与性能估计的隔离原则；2. 八种验证策略系统讲解：hold-out、train/val/test、repeated random subsampling、k-fold与repeated stratified CV、LOO/LpO、group-aware、nested group CV；3. 八个受控仿真场景：七组采用锁定混淆矩阵+可审计指标（含ICI/McNemar等），一组采用可复现重复研究仿真，覆盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、依赖记录、中心混合、测试集复用、估计器不稳定等；4. 偏差-方差-度量聚合-不确定性-计算成本五维度评估；5. 提供数据规模矩阵、决策树、报告清单与MATLAB/scikit-learn模板。
AI.result: 结果显示没有"普适最优"的验证方法；当独立单元与部署目标不匹配时，所有指标均偏向乐观；当特征选择或归一化跨越训练测试边界时，准确性可显著虚增；分组感知与嵌套CV在依赖数据上能恢复无偏估计但代价更高；锁定混淆矩阵与重复研究仿真均能定量揭示泄漏量级；不确定性随折数与重复次数可被合理量化。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论：模型验证的有效性取决于独立单元是否匹配部署目标，以及所有数据依赖操作（特征选择、归一化、超参搜索等）是否严格隔离于性能估计样本；研究者应根据数据结构（EEG epoch、双眼配对OCT、重复临床测量、多中心）选择相应验证策略，并遵循报告清单，使用可复现模板以确保审计与重现。

title: Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training
summary: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散模型在递归训练下的"模型坍缩"现象，研究了一种介于完全替换（last generation）和无限累积（accumulate）之间的"固定预算（fixed-budget/accumulate-subsample）"协议。理论分析与实验均表明：完全替换导致快速、全面的退化；而固定预算协议下，特征呈现"脆弱/鲁棒"二分——大特征值方向（脆弱特征，如分布尾部/稀有样本）在少量代数内即丢失，而小特征值方向（鲁棒特征）可在极长代数内近似保留，从而调和了文献中看似矛盾的结论。
AI.motivation: 已有文献对模型坍缩得出看似矛盾结论：Shumailov等认为合成数据替换真实数据导致坍缩；Gerstgrasser等认为累积真实与合成数据可避免坍缩。作者聚焦于有限预算训练管线中常见的"既累积所有历史数据、又保持每代训练集固定大小"的中间协议（accumulate-subsample），该协议使真实数据占比渐趋于零但永不丢弃数据，旨在从特征层面调和前述争论并解释实践中常见的"部分坍缩"。
AI.method: 1) 提出"末代（last generation）"与"固定预算（fixed budget）"两种递归训练协议；2) 对扩散训练采用DDPM训练+DDIM采样，并假设数据集与模型参数一一对应（"扩散模型假设"）；3) 在参数空间对重训练映射做NTK式一阶Taylor线性化，得到对称正定压缩矩阵M与加性噪声ε；4) 在"特征基"下将多代参数动力学化为随机递推（VAR(1)形式与Borkar型递推），分别用经典随机递推收敛引理推导两种协议的逐点/分布收敛性与逐特征"半衰期"；5) 在2D螺旋、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10上以FID、pixel-FID、W₂进行实证验证。
AI.result: 1) 末代协议：模型参数不逐点收敛，而是收敛于某个非零方差的平稳分布π^LG_T∞，均值以(1−λ)^n指数衰减，半衰期为⌈log2/−log|1−λ|⌉，所有特征在有限代内（最坏约69代）即丢失；2) 固定预算协议：目标参数逐点趋于零，逐特征衰减遵循∏(1−λ/k)≈n^−λ/Γ(1−λ)，半衰期≈e^−γ·2^{1/λ}，小λ（≈0.01）下半衰期高达10^29量级，几乎永不失忆；3) 实验：图像基准与2D螺旋下，末代协议快速退化为接近白噪声；固定预算协议仅丢失部分特征，整体结构（数字形状、衣物类别、场景纹理）得以保留，FID与W₂增长显著低于末代；4) 特征二分为"脆弱特征"（λ~1，关联分布尾部/低密度区域）和"鲁棒特征"（λ~0），为实践中需要真实数据刷新/溯源的内容提供了量化指导。
AI.conclusion: 两种协议不是程度之差而是质的不同：末代协议在有限代内抹去所有特征；固定预算协议使数据特征分化为脆弱与鲁棒两类，脆弱特征快速丢失而鲁棒特征在实际意义上永久保留。这一结果从特征动力学层面统一了Shumailov、Gertsgrasser、Seddik、Barzilai-Shamir等工作的结论，并为大规模训练管线中针对脆弱特征进行真实数据刷新、合成内容披露与溯源追踪提供了理论依据。局限包括：理论为NTK式一阶线性响应、假设较强；特征与语义属性的对应为基于实验的解释性关联；实验采用无条件DDIM采样、小模型从头训练，未涉及大规模预训练微调、引导采样或数据池策展等。

title: Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling
summary: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于离散Wasserstein几何的有限状态空间一步生成建模框架"Discrete Drifting"，通过目标相对KL梯度流定义在可逆马尔可夫核上的转移，借助Markov跳跃在粒子层面实现概率流，并将迭代传输更新分摊到潜变量条件生成器中，使训练时使用迭代动力学但推理保持一步完成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型和流式生成器在推理时需要迭代传输，而Drifting模型通过在训练时摊销迭代实现一步生成。将Drifting扩展到离散数据面临两大障碍：(1)有限状态空间上的粒子无法做无穷小移动；(2)有限空间上标准W₂度量无法诱导有用的无穷小传输结构(W₂~O(√δt)，当δt→0时发散)。因此需要为有限空间找到合适的传输几何及兼容的粒子动力学。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1)基于Maas (2011)的离散Wasserstein几何，使用对数均值移动度(logarithmic mean mobility)和可约、可逆马尔可夫核K定义动态传输距离W_K，使离散热方程成为熵的W_K梯度流；(2)将目标相对KL泛函ℱ_p(q)=KL(q∥p)替换熵泛函，推导出边电流J_{p,q}和归一化无关的logit drift Δ_g(x)，其分解为"模型排斥"和"目标吸引"两项，并通过stop-gradient目标实现Euler离散化；(3)通过取电流的正向部分构造非负跳跃率的Markov跳跃过程作为粒子实现，证明其与law-level梯度流和logit更新均通过前向Euler步精确或二阶一致地等价，并用摊销损失将迭代传输分摊到潜变量条件MLP中。
AI.result: 在32×32周期网格(1024状态)上，控制实验验证了三项结果：(1)精确表格流(无估计/表示/优化误差)显示KL从1.85降至约1.3×10⁻¹⁰，TV从0.71降至7.7×10⁻⁶，且KL耗散与Maas几何预测的离散Fisher信息一致(误差<1%);(2)冻结跳跃转换在law层面与Euler步以机器精度完全等价(残差~10⁻¹⁶)，与logit更新的残差呈拟合斜率2.00的二阶一致性，粒子直方图以O(M^{-1/2})速率收敛；(3)有限容量MLP(3层×128宽，256个潜变量)成功跟踪1600步条件oracle，每步最终训练/留出/边际误差 TV为图1.09×10⁻³，最终边际恢复三个不同权重目标模式。增大拟合批量b可使神经与oracle差距降低一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 结论验证了离散漂移的基本构造：相对KL梯度流在Maas几何下实现，一步生成通过冻结Markov转换摊销保持不变。提出的对数图(logit chart)中归一化无关的漂移和边最优的粒子实现为将Discrete Drifting扩展到结构化离散数据提供了基础。未来工作将聚焦于可扩展的局部比率估计和与强离散扩散及一步基线在真实离散数据上的评估对比。

title: LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Control for Skill-Based Smart Manufacturing
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 31st International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation (ETFA). 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Factories are shifting toward smaller lot sizes with high product customization, requiring frequent re-programming of flexible and reconfigurable automation systems. LLM-based agents can be deployed in two complementary roles: Offline, they generate deterministic production sequences, reducing programming effort; online, they operate live machines and handle unforeseen runtime faults that static programs cannot anticipate. We propose a solution in which each factory module is paired with a dedicated LLM-based agent and an MCP tool server that exposes the module's skills via OPC UA method calls, with agents coordinating over MQTT and grounded by real-time updates of the factory state. We compare three agent architectures (orchestrator, peer-to-peer, and monolithic) across nine production challenges of increasing complexity in a simulation of a physical six-module hexagonal factory, including silent hardware fault detection. The monolithic and peer-to-peer architectures both achieve the highest mean solve rate (93\%), while the orchestrator uniquely resolves a silent conveyor-belt fault in all ten runs by autonomously rerouting plates around the blocked segment. All architectures exhibit emergent fault-diagnosis behavior without any explicit failure-handling logic, establishing standardized MCP tooling, MQTT-based inter-agent communication, and real-time state injection as a viable and reproducible foundation for LLM-programmed smart manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的多智能体控制架构，用于灵活可重构的工厂自动化系统。每个工厂模块配备专用MCP工具服务器（通过OPC UA方法暴露技能），智能体之间通过MQTT协调，并由实时工厂状态注入驱动推理。作者在六模块六边形工厂仿真中，对编排式（Orchestrator）、点对点（Peer-to-Peer）和单体式（Monolithic）三种架构进行了9个递进难度的生产挑战评估。结果显示：单体式与点对点架构平均解题率最高（93%）；编排式架构凭借全局视角在传送带静默故障（挑战9）中实现100%解题率。实验证明无需显式故障处理逻辑即可实现涌现式故障诊断能力，验证了"MCP标准化工具 + MQTT智能体通信 + 实时状态注入"作为LLM驱动智能制造可复现技术基础的可行性。
AI.motivation: 现代制造业正向小批量、高定制化转型，需要频繁重编程柔性自动化系统。传统确定性调度器无法处理静默硬件故障（方法报告成功但无实际物理效果），且需预先穷举所有可恢复条件。LLM智能体可作为离线生产序列生成器与在线实时控制器，弥补传统自动化方法在异常处理与快速重构方面的不足。然而现有方案要么采用单体智能体设计缺乏标准化工具接口，要么使用定制的事件驱动提示而缺少结构化智能体通信协议，尚未有工作将模块化MCP工具、MQTT协调与多智能体架构统一融合。
AI.method: 1) **模块智能体架构设计——每个工厂模块配备专属MCP工具服务器，将OPC UA方法封装为LLM可调用的工具；2) **多智能体协调机制——编排式（中央协调器+6个专业智能体）、点对点（无中心协调，发送方订阅消息边界路由）、单体式（单个智能体直接控制所有模块）三种架构通过MQTT broker进行发布/订阅通信；3) **实时状态注入机制——内部状态追踪器聚合技能完成事件，在每轮推理时将工厂状态作为结构化块添加到prompt前缀，并动态约束工具可用性以防LLM尝试物理上不可能的操作；4) **仿真与LLM部署——基于Python实现六模块六边形传送带工厂仿真（包含装配/检查/回收/AGV交付等模块），使用Gemma4:31B本地推理（Q4_K_M量化）以避免数据中心负载波动干扰实验；5) **评估设计——设计9个递进难度生产挑战（基础流水线→跨模块装配→并行订单→静默硬件故障检测），每挑战运行10次，测量解题率、执行时间、token消耗与工具调用次数。
AI.result: **解题率对比**：单体式与点对点架构平均解题率并列最高（93%），编排式为87%。**架构差异化表现**：单体式在挑战7（边缘1装配模块缺陷）中自主切换备用模块（100% SR），但在挑战9（传送带静默故障）中失败（40% SR），因扩展的上下文最终超出工具调用预算内正确归因故障的能力；点对点架构在孤立的模块故障场景中表现良好，但挑战9中失败（50% SR），因缺乏跨智能体边界的全局重规划机制，诊断信息在传播中被稀释；编排式架构凭借全局传送网络视图在挑战9中实现唯一100% SR（绕行逆时针），但在挑战7中失败（20% SR），中央编排器陷入装配与质检智能体间的死循环（消耗平均1997k token、超时1050s）。**效率对比**：单体式执行最快（163±111s）但token消耗较高（312±294k）；编排式在成功的挑战上token占用最低（44-181k）但易因循环失败激增；点对点token效率最佳（222±143k）但执行最慢（353±157s）。**消融研究**：去掉状态注入后单体式SR从93%降至88%（挑战9从40%降至20%，挑战7/8从100%降至90%），证实实时状态注入对可靠故障诊断至关重要。所有架构均展现出无显式故障处理逻辑的涌现式故障诊断行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文是首个将MCP工具服务器与OPC UA在多智能体LLM工厂自动化框架中集成的工作。结论表明：1) **无单一架构在所有指标上最优**——单体式简单且可靠、问题与执行时间最优；编排式选最适合"带式路由挑战且具备全局视角的场景；点对点选最适合"需要token高效且故障相对局部化的场景；2) **实时状态注入是可靠故障诊断的关键**——LLM需借助外部状态区分真实硬件故障与推断错误状态；3) **所有架构均展现出无显式编程的涌现式故障诊断能力**，验证了"MCP标准化工具 + MQTT智能体通信 + 实时状态注入"是LLM编程智能制造的可复现技术基础；4) **未来方向**——未来将探索边缘NPU硬件上量化模型的部署可行性，以及将LLM智能体从实时控制器转向离线生产程序生成器（仿真验证后由人工审核部署）的混合范式，同时需评估真实网络延迟与带宽约束下的系统表现。

title: LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction
summary: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种端到端框架，用于自动发现和生成本体网络（Ontology Network）中的类型化、有依据的语义链接。该框架结合领域适配的DistilBERT嵌入、基于聚类的候选预筛选和GPT-4o关系生成。在Reproduce中ON（33个本体，涵盖机器学习、显微镜、计算科学和实验工作流四个领域）上的实验表明，整体精度达80.19%，F1达0.890，显著优于Sentence-BERT等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现代科学研究需要跨学科知识整合，但单一本体难以胜任。本体网络（ON）通过类型化语义链接实现互操作性。然而手动策划跨域、类型化、有依据的语义链接难以规模化。经典对齐方法（LogMap、AML）只能识别等价概念，无法生成类型化的语义关系；基于嵌入的方法（如OWL2Vec*、RDF2Vec）虽提升规模，但无法在高相似度候选间区分有效与无效关系；现有LLM方法缺乏系统预筛选、迭代提示工程和基于角色化的具体实例化。因此需要一种融合嵌入、LLM推理和本体设计模式的新方法。
AI.method: 六阶段流水线：(1)本体解析与过滤——使用owlready2提取类类型RDF三元组；(2)上下文嵌入生成——在领域丰富句子上对DistilBERT进行MLM微调（学习率5e-5、批次大小16、25个epoch，使用AdamW优化器、早停、最佳模型检查点）；(3)相似度与聚类过滤——KMeans聚类（Elbow和Silhouette选择簇数）+ 簇内余弦相似度+第90百分位动态阈值，将80万对缩减至9.5万对；(4)LLM关系生成——GPT-4o结合迭代提示工程（上下文线索、任务约束、思维链分解、少量示例），定义9种预定义关系类型（层次、功能、因果、时间、空间、组成、比较、转化、工具）；(5)基于角色的映射——将链接映射为Provider、Consumer、Enabler等操作语义角色，基于AgentRole和参与模式ODP；(6)专家验证与评估。
AI.result:
在Reproduce中ON上的实验结果：
• 在29个生成的关系上，双专家人工验证：总体精度80.19%（高精度标注91.49%），344/429有效；274对双重标注的Cohen's κ=0.723（实质性一致）
• 在929对性平衡计算集上：F1=0.890，AUC-ROC=0.927
• 超越最佳基线Sentence-BERT（F1=0.581）30.9个百分点
• 五个相似方法（Jaccard、TF-IDF、预训练DistilBERT等）AUC≈0.5，确认相似度无法区分有效/无效关系
• 关系类型分布：Enables占22.84%，Requires占13.75%
• 域内精度83.58%）高于域间精度75.25%；因果/比较/层次关系精度最高（95-100%），工具关系最易出错（65.22%）
• 链接分布：51.3%域间链接，20%域内链接
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功展示了一种用于本体网络构建的端到端、可复现流水线，融合领域适配嵌入、聚类候选筛选、LLM推理和角色化映射。核心贡献在于证明：LLM关于概念角色和领域依赖的推理（而非语义相似度）是精度的关键驱动因素。嵌入预筛选在规范上不可或缺——将80万对缩减至9.5万对，实现计算可行性。未来工作将探索开源指令调优模型替代GPT-4o以降低成本，通过构建受测曲标准数据集实现完整召回率测量，整合溯源本体领域，以及扩展基于角色的映射以实现SPARQL推理和工作流生成。主要局限性包括：仅单一数据集验证、GPT-4o随机性影响可复现性、随机负样本可能夸大F1分数、角色分配正确性缺乏独立评估。

title: Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs
comment: Accepted at the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGO（Stability-Aware Generalization Objective）框架，将LLM的"泛化能力"重新定义为在语义等价输入变化下行为的逐实例稳定性，而非传统的聚合准确率。通过11个LLM、6个数据集和4个行为轴（激活几何、生成一致性、置信度/不确定性、响应镜像）的多轴评估，发现泛化不稳定现象普遍存在且各行为轴捕捉相互独立的失败模式，跨数据集变化甚至可以逆转模型排名。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM泛化评估通常依赖单一提示格式、任务或变化集的聚合准确率，将鲁棒性与整体基准性能混为一谈。这种评估方式可能掩盖逐实例层面的显著行为变化，导致对模型泛化能力的误判。本文认为泛化应被理解为模型在相同输入的不同语义等价表达下保持行为稳定的能力，而非聚合分数。
AI.method: 提出SAGO框架，包含三个核心组件：（1）多数据集×多变化族×多行为轴的综合基准；（2）逐提示稳定性评分（SGS），采用归一化增量在各轴上的RMS聚合；（3）四个独立行为轴：激活几何（X_Act，层间余弦相似度）、生成一致性（X_BLEU/X_BERT，BLEU和BERTScore）、置信度/不确定性（X_Prob/X_Ent，序列对数概率和token级熵）、响应镜像（X_MR，二元检测器）。变化族包括社会语域（11级礼貌度）、表面噪声（间距/标点/大小写）和结构改写（长度变化/句式转换）。使用单侧t检验在容差阈值ε∈{0.01, 0.05, 0.10}下检验稳定性。评估11个LLM（8个开源：Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2B/7B/4-E4B、Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B、Qwen3.5-9B；3个闭源：GPT-5.4、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Claude-Sonnet-4.6）在6个开放领域问答数据集（TruthfulQA、Natural Questions、Alpaca、SimpleQA Verified、TriviaQA、HotpotQA）上的表现。
AI.result: （1）所有模型均存在显著的泛化不稳定现象，Δ-BLEU和Δ-MR在p<0.001下对所有模型显著；Δ-Ent在所有模型中保持在可接受阈值内（最大0.012），表明token级分布锐度与输出级稳定性解耦。（2）行为轴之间相互独立：G4-E4B具有最高的生成不稳定性（Δ-BERT: 0.178）但前代更低；Q3.5-9B生成最稳定（Δ-BERT: 0.080）却置信度最不稳定（Δ-Prob: 0.088）且镜像不稳定性高（Δ-MR: 0.441），揭示了不同模型在轴上的系统性反转。（3）跨数据集变化巨大，如L-8B的Δ-Cos跨数据集跨度达3.7倍，足以逆转模型排名。（4）模型规模增大（L-8B、G-7B、Q-7B相对其小版本）并未消除不稳定现象。（5）闭源模型整体不稳定性并不低于开源模型。
AI.conclusion: SAGO将LLM泛化重新定义为相同目标和上下文在语义等价输入形式下的行为稳定性，揭示了三个关键发现：泛化应按逐实例、多轴方式评估而非聚合基准分；行为轴捕捉相互独立的失败模式，生成一致性最敏感，置信度与内容稳定性独立；模型排名在不同数据集下可能反转，且能力提升（如规模、架构进步）不自动转化为泛化稳定性提升。该框架主张稳健性声明应限定于评估的具体轴、域和变化族，模型比较应基于行为画像而非单一排名。局限包括：仅英语、依赖GPT-4o-mini作为部分变化和镜像的评判工具、闭源API限制了部分轴的可评估性。未来方向包括多语言扩展、任务家族扩展、通过中介分析或激活补丁将行为画像与因果机制关联，以及评估训练干预是否在轴、数据集和语义等价输入形式间转移。

title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Follow-up to arXiv:2603.12123 and arXiv:2603.21454
summary: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型(LLM)验证中"跨模型评审"的有效性，通过900次评审会话的受控实验，探讨不同模型评审是否能比同模型评审发现更多独立错误。研究结论是：顶级跨模型评审与同模型评审在F1上无显著差异，但两者发现的部分错误互补（Jaccard 41.2%）；在两次评审调用中，一次同模型评审+一次跨模型评审的组合比两次同模型评审匹配更多已植入错误（56.7% vs 42.7%），但与两次顶级跨模型评审相比无显著差异。模型差异与评审者能力无法分离。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于生成代码、文档和分析，人工审查速度跟不上产出速度。虽然LLM已开始作为评审者被集成到工业工具中，但关于"独立性"（即评审是否独立于生成过程）以及跨模型审查是否能提高缺陷检测率的问题尚不明确。现有研究仅在单一模型内探索了上下文、时间、结构三个维度的独立性，而最直观的"使用不同模型"这一维度尚未被系统测试。
AI.method: 提出四维独立性框架：上下文独立性(C)、时间独立性(T)、结构独立性(S)、模型独立性(M)，以及信息限制(R)作为横切修饰符。设计了10个实验条件映射这些维度，使用30个工件（共150个植入错误，涵盖5种错误类型），由3个评审模型（来自2个开发者，分别为GPT-5.4顶级、Gemini 2.5 Pro能力级、Gemini 2.5 Flash轻量级）在10种条件下进行评审，共900次评审会话。使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm-Bonferroni校正）进行统计推断，通过Jaccard相似度量化发现重叠度，并按工件类型和错误类型进行细分分析。此外还进行了5个外部案例研究（B1-B5）和对ReaLMistake公共数据的部分外部验证。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 顶级跨模型评审XMR-GPT（F1 32.3%）与同模型评审CCR（F1 28.6%）之间无统计学显著差异；(2) CCR与XMR-GPT-R之间的Jaccard相似度为41.2%，表明两者具有部分互补性；(3) 在两次评审调用的匹配分析中，一次CCR+一次XMR-GPT-R匹配85/150（56.7%）个错误，而两次CCR仅匹配64/150（42.7%）（Holm调整后p=0.006），但与两次顶级XMR评审相比无显著差异；(4) 按类别细分时出现反转：CCR在代码类工件上更优（F1 40.7% vs XMR-GPT 37.2%），而XMR在文档类工件上更优（F1 42.1% vs CCR 24.5%）；(5) 评审者能力层级间的差异（8.3pp）大于同模型条件间的总差异（6.9pp），表明能力可能比独立性本身更重要；(6) 轻量级跨模型评审不优于同模型评审；(7) 跨模型评审引入了9.4%的"模型偏差"假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出了谨慎的指导建议：(1) 为获得最大覆盖率，应结合同模型评审与跨模型评审（56.7% vs 42.7%）；(2) 单次最佳方案是使用顶级评审者进行跨模型评审（F1 32.1-32.3%）；(3) 代码项目应优先同模型评审，文档/一致性任务应优先跨模型评审；(4) 避免使用轻量级模型进行跨模型评审。然而，主要F1比较均不显著（仅SR2与CCR显著不同），且模型差异与评审者能力无法分离，因此结论是描述性的而非确立性的。未来工作需要因子化设计，将生成者、评审者模型和上下文独立变化，并在成熟基准（如FEVER、CUAD）上进行评估。

title: No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse
summary: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($\beta = 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($\rho = +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Kontoyiannis熵率估计器Ĥ_K的完全无模型训练数据过滤方法，用于缓解大语言模型迭代微调中的模型崩溃问题。该方法仅通过原始文本的匹配长度统计计算，无需任何模型访问、API调用或外部oracle，在六代QLoRA微调实验中显著优于基于logprob的surplexity过滤方法。
AI.motivation: 现有模型崩溃缓解方法存在三类局限：(A) 基于模型logprob的方法（如surplexity）需要前向传播访问模型分布，对闭源API不可用；(B) 外部oracle方法引入额外模型偏差；(C) 真实数据累积方法需要持续的人类数据来源。本文旨在探索一种第四类方法——完全无模型的文本过滤方案，仅依赖原始文本即可缓解微调崩溃。
AI.method: 核心方法采用Kontoyiannis熵率估计器Ĥ_K = (n·log₂n) / ΣΛᵢ，其中Λᵢ表示位置i处文本中尚未出现过的最短前缀长度。该估计器基于Shannon-McMillan-Breiman定理，对平稳遍历过程几乎处处收敛于真实熵率，与Lempel-Ziv压缩率有内在联系。实验设计包括三组六代QLoRA微调对比（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）：无过滤、Ĥ_L（logprob熵）过滤、Ĥ_K过滤，每代80个文档跨4个领域生成，按领域分层选取40个训练。验证实验涵盖跨领域（4个领域）、跨温度（T∈{0.5,1.0}）、跨模型对（GPT-4o/Qwen、Gemini/Qwen）的Ĥ_K与Ĥ_L相关性分析。
AI.result: 在六代微调实验中，Ĥ_K过滤在所有文本多样性指标上均取得显著改进：独特trigrams +42%、词汇量 +30%、intra-document 4-gram重复 -19%（均p<0.001）。相比之下，Ĥ_L过滤在所有文本多样性指标上无显著改善（p>0.23）。验证实验显示Ĥ_K与Ĥ_L在跨领域跨模型条件下具有稳定的代理关系（β=0.924, R²=0.746, 域不变斜率）。在微调崩溃检测中，主题内Spearman一致性ρ=+0.454（p<0.0001）。Ĥ_K过滤还产生轻微的质量提升（指令遵循p=0.020），且未发现连贯性代价。然而，文本多样性保持未能转化为通用推理能力的保持——HellaSwag、MMLU、GSM8K在三种条件下均同等退化。Ĥ_K过滤存在小幅跨文档同质化代价（Self-BLEU-4 = 0.086 vs 0.060–0.075）。方法局限性在于仅适用于微调崩溃场景（对迭代改写无效），且仅保持词法层面的多样性（MAUVE分数近天花板）。
